items.title_en: A fast and accurate model for gradient-based inverse design of multimode waveguides
items.title_zh: 用于多模波导基于梯度逆向设计的快速准确模型
items.abstract_en: Multimode photonic inverse design requires fast, accurate computational models that provide geometry gradients. Based on coupled-mode theory (CMT), we propose a differentiable surrogate model. Its parameter-extraction method uses a change of modal basis to obtain coupled-mode parameters from cross-sectional mode data. We also provide a complete, easy-to-implement propagation and optimization workflow. Using finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulation data as a common reference, we compare the prediction accuracy of our model and forward dataset-based eigenmode expansion (EME) for randomly generated thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) waveguide profiles that traverse modal coupling regions. Using identical modal libraries, the model reduces the maximum per-mode mean absolute transmission error by 17-37% compared with forward EME. We demonstrate a spot-size converter design that preserves the fundamental TM$_0$ mode in its hybridization region with the first-order TE$_1$ mode and obtain nine structures, each with FDTD-verified transmission above 98%. These tests demonstrate the model's utility for large-scale photonic inverse design, enabling rapid exploration of the design parameter space by combining gradient information with improved prediction accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 多模光子逆向设计需要快速、准确且能提供几何梯度的计算模型。基于耦合模理论（CMT），我们提出一种可微代理模型。其参数提取方法利用模态基变换，从横截面模数据中获得耦合模参数。我们还提供完整且易于实现的传播与优化工作流。以时域有限差分（FDTD）仿真数据作为共同参考，我们针对随机生成、跨越模态耦合区域的薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）波导轮廓，比较我们的模型与基于前向数据集的本征模展开（EME）的预测精度。在使用相同模态库时，与正向 EME 相比，该模型将每个模式的最大平均绝对透射误差降低了 17–37%。我们展示了一种光斑尺寸转换器设计，该设计在与一阶 TE$_1$ 模的杂化区域中保持基模 TM$_0$，并获得了九个结构，每个结构经 FDTD 验证的透射率均高于 98%。这些测试证明了该模型用于大规模光子逆向设计的实用性，通过将梯度信息与改进的预测精度相结合，可快速探索设计参数空间。

items.title_en: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
items.title_zh: 通过蒸馏 Oracle 教师进行主动特征获取
items.abstract_en: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 获取一个实例的每个特征通常代价高昂：一次测量可能带来金钱成本、时间延迟或隐私成本。主动特征获取（AFA）通过学习一个策略来解决这一问题，该策略按实例决定在预算内获取哪些特征。现有 AFA 方法通过优化自行构建的效用目标来训练该策略，而不是蒸馏一个明确的教师。我们明确构建了这个教师。在训练时，标签和未观测到的特征值是可用的，它们共同以闭式确定教师：一个 oracle，根据每个候选对下游预测器误差的影响对其进行排序。OracleImitator 通过软目标模仿将该排序蒸馏为一个可部署的策略。在多模态医学诊断和 AFABench 基准上，OracleImitator 在整个预算范围内达到或优于现有 AFA 方法，在以不到四分之一获取成本的情况下恢复了 90% 的可达到精度增益。由于教师是一个明确的算法对象而非隐式优化目标，我们还可以直接测量一个受限于部署时可见信息的策略能够恢复其排序的多少。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement
items.title_zh: dLoop：通过循环潜在细化实现环式扩散语言模型
items.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support parallel generation, yet they often require many denoising steps because only a fraction of token predictions are sufficiently reliable to be committed at each step. Existing acceleration methods primarily optimize confidence learning or commitment policies. However, these approaches operate on the outputs of a single denoising forward pass, in which information from the prompt, previously committed tokens, and uncommitted positions may not yet be fully integrated. Consequently, some predictions remain under-refined when the commitment decision is made, and modifying the commitment policy alone cannot improve their underlying representations. We introduce dLoop, which restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda architecture and recurrently applies a parameter-shared intermediate block to the same partially masked state. Rather than advancing the denoising process, each additional loop provides further latent computation, allowing information distributed across uncommitted positions to continue interacting and become more fully integrated before commitment. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH, MBPP, and HumanEval show that dLoop achieves the highest or tied-highest accuracy on every benchmark. With tokens per forward pass (TPF) adjusted for loop computation, it outperforms Fast-dLLM in both accuracy and TPF on all four benchmarks and dParallel on three, and is more accurate than d3LLM on all four, while d3LLM attains higher TPF; no compared method surpasses dLoop in both. Mechanistic analyses show that extra loops mainly help on slow, unstable trajectories and that updates at uncommitted positions drive changes in token decisions and later generation. Pre-commitment latent computation thus makes predictions more reliable, offering a route to DLM acceleration distinct from forcing confidence through the training loss.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）支持并行生成，但通常需要许多去噪步骤，因为每一步只有一部分 token 预测足够可靠而可被提交。现有加速方法主要优化置信度学习或提交策略。然而，这些方法作用于单次去噪前向传播的输出，其中来自提示、先前已提交 token 和未提交位置的信息可能尚未完全整合。因此，在做出提交决策时，一些预测仍未充分细化，而仅修改提交策略无法改善其底层表示。我们引入 dLoop，它将预训练扩散语言模型重构为 Prelude-Loop-Coda 架构，并对同一部分掩码状态循环应用参数共享的中间块。每个额外循环不是推进去噪过程，而是提供更多潜在计算，使分布在未提交位置上的信息继续交互，并在提交前更充分地整合。在 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP 和 HumanEval 上的实验表明，dLoop 在每个基准上取得最高或并列最高的准确率。在针对循环计算调整每次前向传播的 token 数（TPF）后，它在全部四个基准上在准确率和 TPF 两方面均优于 Fast-dLLM，在三个基准上优于 dParallel，并且在全部四个基准上比 d3LLM 更准确，而 d3LLM 获得更高的 TPF；没有对比方法在两方面都超过 dLoop。机制分析表明，额外循环主要有助于缓慢、不稳定的轨迹，并且未提交位置上的更新驱动 token 决策及后续生成的变化。因此，提交前潜在计算使预测更可靠，提供了一条不同于通过训练损失强制置信度的 DLM 加速路径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
items.title_zh: PhyDEX：基于动态外在灵巧性的视觉-语言-动作模型物理推理基准
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在语言条件机器人操作方面发展迅速，但现有基准主要评估夹爪与物体的接触，并在很大程度上忽略物体如何通过重力、摩擦、惯性和质量分布与环境交互。因此，当前策略是真正理解物理，还是仅从训练数据中插值，仍不清楚。我们通过动态外在灵巧性的视角填补这一空白，并引入 PhyDEX，一个投掷基准，其中机器人必须推断物体的质量、质心和摩擦，将其送到运动学工作空间之外的目的地。PhyDEX 包含跨越九个任务和 100 个场景的 35K 条轨迹（143 小时），涵盖均匀质量、不规则质量和动态质量物体，以及静态、多个和移动目的地。所有数据均由可扩展的全自动流水线生成，该流水线结合了抓取生成、运动规划以及在随机化物理属性下的闭环投掷优化。我们评估了三种代表性 VLA：GR00T N1.7、DynamicVLA 和 ForceVLA，发现它们的成功率均低于 3%。我们的分析揭示两个关键瓶颈：预训练模型鲁棒性有限，导致大多数失败发生在投掷之前；以及物理盲，因为提供真实物理属性可使成功率大约翻倍。在人形机器人和真实世界中的实验显示出相同的失败模式。我们希望 PhyDEX 将推动基于物理的机器人策略的发展。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
items.title_zh: FirstCross：从稀疏视角进行凸单光子三维重建
items.abstract_en: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons. However, leading neural methods such as Transientangelo require over an hour of non-convex per-scene optimization, and their accuracy degrades as photon flux decreases. We propose FirstCross, a network-free approach that instead solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid. For a solid object, the Poisson likelihood of a ray with given signal and background rates depends on the scene solely through its first crossing, the point where the ray first enters the object. Decomposing this likelihood yields two tractable terms. The first penalizes surfaces in front of detected photons and admits a tight convex closure, namely volume rendering with a running-maximum transmittance in place of NeRF's product transmittance. The second accounts for photons that no surface explains and admits a convex upper bound once the object is assumed to be thick behind each detected surface point. Compared with Transientangelo under its own real-data protocol, FirstCross achieves lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With three views and 100 times fewer photons than at the protocol's lowest flux, our mean object depth error stays under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Given our detected surface points, the best classical fusion has 1.3 to 1.8 times our three-view error across flux levels. On real room-scale captures with 1% of their photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8 to 7.7 times our error. FirstCross lets few-view single-photon scanners cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct an object in about a minute on one GPU.
items.abstract_zh: 单光子激光雷达记录每个返回光子的到达时间，从而能够利用少量视角和极少光子完成三维重建。然而，Transientangelo 等主流神经方法需要超过一小时的非凸逐场景优化，且精度随光子通量下降而退化。我们提出 FirstCross，一种无需网络的方案，它在体素网格上求解一系列短小的凸问题。对实心物体而言，给定信号率与背景率时，一条光线的泊松似然仅通过其“首次穿越”点（光线首次进入物体的位置）依赖场景，分解该似然可得到两个易于处理的分项：第一项惩罚位于已探测光子之前的表面，并具有紧致的凸松弛——即以运行最大值透射率替代 NeRF 的乘积透射率进行体渲染；第二项解释无表面可解释的光子，在假设每个探测表面点后方物体足够厚时具有凸上界。在与 Transientangelo 相同的真实数据协议下，FirstCross 在每个测试场景、视角数与通量水平上都取得更低的深度误差；在三个视角、光子数比该协议最低通量还少 100 倍时，其平均物体深度误差仍不到 Transientangelo 使用全部光子时的一半。基于我们探测到的表面点，最佳经典融合方法在各通量水平下的误差是我们的三视角误差的 1.3 至 1.8 倍。在仅使用 1% 光子的真实房间尺度采集中，TransientNeRF 的误差是我们的 2.8 至 7.7 倍。FirstCross 使少视角单光子扫描仪可将曝光降至 1%，并在单块 GPU 上约一分钟内完成物体重建。
items.highlight_zh: 用凸优化代替神经优化，一分钟、1%光子即可重建
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：单光子激光雷达能记录单个光子返回的时间，理论上用很少的拍摄视角和极少的 photons 就能重建物体的三维形状。但现有最强的神经方法（如 Transientangelo）要对每个场景单独做非凸优化，耗时超过一小时，而且光子越少精度越差。作者希望找到一种又快又稳、低光子下依然准确的替代方案。

2. 用了什么方法：关键洞察来自“首次穿越”概念——对不透明实心物体，一条光线是否打到物体、以及泊松似然的大小，只取决于它第一次进入物体的那个点。把该似然拆成两项：一项惩罚出现在已探测光子之前的虚假表面，可写成紧致的凸形式，相当于在体渲染中用“运行最大值透射率”替换 NeRF 的乘积透射率；另一项处理没有任何表面能解释的光子，在假设探测点后方物体足够厚的前提下也有凸上界。于是整个重建变成在体素网格上解几个小型凸问题，完全不需要训练神经网络。

3. 有什么结果：在与 Transientangelo 相同的真实数据评测协议下，FirstCross 在每一个测试场景、每种视角数量和每个光子通量水平上深度误差都更低；在 3 个视角、光子数比协议最低通量还少 100 倍时，其平均深度误差仍不到对手用全部光子时的一半。与传统点云融合方法相比，误差只有对方的 1/1.3 到 1/1.8；在真实房间尺度数据上只用 1% 光子，误差仅为 TransientNeRF 的 1/2.8 到 1/7.7。整个重建在一块 GPU 上约一分钟完成。

4. 为何重要：它把“每场景训练网络”的昂贵范式换成了可直接求解的凸优化，让少视角单光子扫描仪把曝光时间和激光功率降到 1% 仍能成像，对低功耗、快速、抗噪声的实际三维感知（如自动驾驶、机器人、远距离成像）很有价值，也说明经典凸建模在极低光子条件下仍可与深度学习方法竞争。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
items.title_zh: 心脏 MRI 信息引导的心电图实现具有生物学基础的心肌病检测
items.abstract_en: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information. Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. In a multi-reader study of six cardiologists, MyoECG assistance improved mean sensitivity by 0.109 (95% CI, 0.041-0.175; P = 0.009) and specificity by 0.056 (95% CI, 0.004-0.108; P = 0.040). In 41,128 UK Biobank participants, the MyoECG score showed genetic correlations with cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.409) and dilated cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.371), genome-wide associations at four loci, including regions mapped to NFIA and KCNQ1, and associations with 69 circulating proteins related to myocardial stress, cell adhesion, vascular biology and metabolism. The cardiomyopathy correlation attenuated to non-significance after adjustment for 27 measured CMR traits (rg = 0.131; P = 0.143), indicating that the score captures CMR-derived information rather than dataset-specific shortcuts. MyoECG offers a scalable route to CMR-informed cardiomyopathy assessment and a strategy for transferring knowledge from resource-intensive imaging to widely deployable physiological signals.
items.abstract_zh: 在人群规模上进行精确心肌表型分析受限于心脏磁共振（CMR）的成本和可及性，而心电图（ECG）广泛可用，但反映的是电信息而非结构和功能信息。在此，我们开发了 MyoECG，一种跨模态表示学习框架，可将 CMR 中的心肌结构和功能知识蒸馏到标准 12 导联 ECG 中，从而能够仅凭 ECG 进行影像信息引导的心肌病检测和亚型分类。MyoECG 在来自 UK Biobank 和一家三级心血管中心的 45,241 对 ECG-CMR 检查上进行预训练，随后在来自七个独立数据集的超过 180 万份 ECG 上进行开发和验证。在涵盖 0.2%–54.7% 患病率的内部和外部数据集中，MyoECG 优于五个预训练 ECG 基础模型，心肌病检测的 AUROC 为 0.800–0.974。在一项由六名心脏病专家参与的多读者研究中，MyoECG 辅助将平均灵敏度提高了 0.109（95% CI，0.041–0.175；P = 0.009），特异度提高了 0.056（95% CI，0.004–0.108；P = 0.040）。在 41,128 名 UK Biobank 参与者中，MyoECG 评分显示出与心肌病（rg = 0.409）和扩张型心肌病（rg = 0.371）的遗传相关性，在四个位点存在全基因组关联，包括映射到 NFIA 和 KCNQ1 的区域，并与 69 种与心肌应激、细胞黏附、血管生物学和代谢相关的循环蛋白相关。在调整 27 个测量的 CMR 特征后，心肌病相关性减弱至不显著（rg = 0.131；P = 0.143），表明该评分捕获的是 CMR 衍生信息，而非数据集特异性捷径。MyoECG 为 CMR 信息引导的心肌病评估提供了一条可扩展路径，并提供了一种将知识从资源密集型影像转移到可广泛部署的生理信号的策略。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
items.title_zh: 横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结中取向可调的界面热导：深度势分子动力学研究
items.abstract_en: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m$^2$K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m$^2$K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.
items.abstract_zh: 管理横向二维过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）异质结界面上的热流是下一代纳米电子和光电子器件的一项关键挑战。为应对这一问题，我们使用 DeePMD-kit 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）数据训练了一个深度学习原子间势（DLP），然后将其与非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）模拟相结合，研究横向 MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ 异质结中的界面热导（ITC），同时考虑扶手椅型和锯齿型界面取向。我们训练的势与 DFT 能量、力和声子色散关系高度吻合，这证实了其用于热输运模拟的可靠性。检查 10 至 40 nm 的晶胞长度并外推到无限长度，扶手椅型界面显示出比锯齿型界面更高的 ITC（473 MW/m$^2$K 对 387 MW/m$^2$K），并且在所考虑的每个长度下扶手椅型界面都保持更高。两者都随温度升高而进一步增加。在 300 K 时，振动态密度显示扶手椅型界面处的声子谱重叠大于锯齿型界面。总之，这些结果为研究横向 TMD 异质结中的热输运提供了一个可靠的机器学习框架，并将界面取向确定为控制这些结处热耗散的有效手段。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Efficient and Variation-Tolerant Tree Inference via Compact and Scalable Mapping in Analog CAMs
items.title_zh: 通过模拟 CAM 中的紧凑且可扩展映射实现高效且变异容忍的树推断
items.abstract_en: Tree-based machine learning methods are widely adopted for their interpretability and state-of-the-art accuracy on tabular data. These methods face efficiency challenges on conventional architectures due to irregular memory access patterns during tree traversal. Prior work uses analog CAM to accelerate tree traversal, but inefficient mapping requires exponentially more analog CAM columns as tree depth increases. Accuracy is also degraded by device non-idealities such as programming variations and soft decision boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose ACTIVAR, a compact variation-tolerant tree implementation in a dense analog CAM array via software-hardware codesign. On the software side, we introduce an analog-CAM-aware compact tree model that employs hierarchical subtrees with shared features to maximize hardware utilization. This dense mapping introduces redundancy, improving both model accuracy and hardware defect tolerance. Additionally, we develop Variation-Enhanced Training, which utilizes a fuzzy overlap boundary strategy to build models resilient to analog noise. On the hardware side, we design a FeFET-based analog CAM cell with a driver to sharpen decision thresholds and implement a pipelined multi-core architecture to optimize throughput and energy consumption. Across 13 classification and regression datasets, ACTIVAR maintains near-software-level accuracy while reducing hardware overhead by up to 99% compared with prior analog-CAM-based soft-tree designs. Under realistic hardware noise conditions, ACTIVAR limits accuracy degradation to just 3.7% on the MNIST dataset, whereas baseline models suffer a catastrophic 49.6% drop. Furthermore, the ACTIVAR architecture achieves energy efficiency gains ranging from $10^4$ to $10^6$ times over commercial general-purpose processors, establishing it as a highly efficient solution for high-capacity machine learning at the edge.
items.abstract_zh: 基于树的机器学习方法因其可解释性和在表格数据上的最先进精度而被广泛采用。由于树遍历期间的不规则内存访问模式，这些方法在传统架构上面临效率挑战。先前工作使用模拟 CAM 加速树遍历，但低效映射会随着树深度增加而需要指数级更多的模拟 CAM 列。精度还会因编程变异和软决策边界等器件非理想性而下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ACTIVAR，一种通过软硬件协同设计在密集模拟 CAM 阵列中实现的紧凑且变异容忍的树实现。在软件方面，我们引入一种感知模拟 CAM 的紧凑树模型，采用具有共享特征的分层子树以最大化硬件利用率。这种密集映射引入了冗余，同时提高了模型精度和硬件缺陷容忍度。此外，我们开发了变异增强训练（Variation-Enhanced Training），利用模糊重叠边界策略构建对模拟噪声具有鲁棒性的模型。在硬件方面，我们设计了一种带有驱动器的基于 FeFET 的模拟 CAM 单元以锐化决策阈值，并实现流水线多核架构以优化吞吐量和能耗。在 13 个分类和回归数据集上，ACTIVAR 保持接近软件级别的精度，同时与先前基于模拟 CAM 的软树设计相比将硬件开销降低多达 99%。在真实硬件噪声条件下，ACTIVAR 在 MNIST 数据集上将精度下降限制在仅 3.7%，而基线模型则遭受灾难性的 49.6% 下降。此外，ACTIVAR 架构相较商用通用处理器实现了 $10^4$ 到 $10^6$ 倍的能效提升，使其成为边缘高容量机器学习的高效解决方案。

items.title_en: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
items.title_zh: 医学大语言模型中的可验证逻辑：智能体式临床推理优化与神经符号接地的批判性综述
items.abstract_en: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. Within their encoded domains, systems with symbolic veto layers offer guarantees that hold relative to their encoded knowledge, and they report large gains on the safety measures they use. These results come from single studies, mostly in simulated or small-sample settings, and are not directly comparable with neural baselines. Process reward models remain bounded by the statistics of their training data. We propose a conceptual framework that maps each agentic failure mode to a symbolic intervention point, and we argue that clinical AI safety depends substantially on system architecture. Because current regulation emphasizes performance and does not require verification of reasoning steps, we argue that responsible certification should also audit reasoning trajectories alongside accuracy on static benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 临床大语言模型通常根据最终答案是否正确来评判。然而，模型可能通过静态基准无法检测的无效推理得到流畅、看似合理的输出，而自信的幻觉、因果无效的推断和虚假的人口学捷径可以通过常规评估。本批判性综述依次涵盖四种范式：临床幻觉如何产生以及为何静态指标会漏检它；智能体式幻觉级联，其中多智能体和工具增强系统传播并放大早期推理错误；过程奖励建模作为步骤级监督；以及神经符号接地，其中形式逻辑引擎、本体推理器和知识图谱对神经输出施加可验证的约束。在其编码领域内，带有符号否决层的系统提供相对于其编码知识成立的保证，并且它们在其使用的安全指标上报告了大幅提升。这些结果来自单项研究，大多在模拟或小样本环境中，不能直接与神经基线比较。过程奖励模型仍受其训练数据统计特性的限制。我们提出一个概念框架，将每种智能体式失败模式映射到符号干预点，并认为临床 AI 安全性在很大程度上取决于系统架构。由于当前监管强调性能而不要求验证推理步骤，我们认为负责任的认证还应审计推理轨迹以及静态基准上的准确率。

items.title_en: ACE-Brain-0.7: Learning Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Embodied Agents
items.title_zh: ACE-Brain-0.7：为具身智能体学习执行接地的推理
items.abstract_en: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程具身任务的可靠推理需要以观测到的执行状态为依据的预测。我们提出 ACE-Brain-0.7，一个 9B 视觉语言模型，结合了空间接地、任务理解和进度估计。为训练该模型，我们整理了 370 万个问答对，从第一人称人类视频、机器人回合和仿真中获取执行监督。这些问题跨越执行的不同阶段，并将任务级判断与观测到的进度和结果联系起来。然后，我们在该集合以及额外的任务、空间接地和进度估计数据上微调 Qwen3.5-9B。在六个公开任务推理基准上，ACE-Brain-0.7 取得 76.5 的平均分，领先于 GPT-6 Astra 的 72.7 和 Claude Opus 5.5 的 73.5。我们的模型在空间接地方面也在受评估模型中领先，在七个基准上平均 75.90，并在 RefCOCOg 上达到 91.25 Acc@0.5。受控评估进一步表明，我们的仅任务模型更有效地利用视觉历史，并更准确地区分执行状态。总之，这些结果表明 ACE-Brain-0.7 有效结合了空间感知与时间理解，提供强大的执行接地推理，并与闭源模型相比具有优势。

items.title_en: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
items.title_zh: WHU-Road3D：面向精细路面制图的数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}.
items.abstract_zh: 准确提取并制图路面要素对于高精度地图、道路资产管理和智能交通系统等应用至关重要。本研究首先对用于提取与制图道路要素的基准数据集进行了全面回顾，涵盖从俯视到透视数据、从大范围到局部尺度、从粗到细的细节。随后，我们深入回顾了提取路面要素的相关方法。然而，我们认为现有数据集在语义丰富度、数据模态多样性和场景复杂度方面仍需改进。为弥补这些不足，本文提出 WHU-Road3D，一个用于精细路面制图的大规模多模态数据集，以解决上述缺陷。WHU-Road3D 提供约 100 km 的中国多样化高速公路与城市街道。它融合了 MLS 点云、关联全景影像、车辆轨迹、详细矢量标注以及路面要素的逐点实例标注。该数据集细致标注了 15 类不同的道路要素，包括道路边界、斑马线、车道分隔线、停止线等常见标线，以及 10 种方向符号。据我们所知，WHU-Road3D 是首个可对如此全面范围的路面要素进行制图的多模态数据集，旨在促进路面实例分割、全要素提取与制图的前沿研究。除这些直接应用外，WHU-Road3D 还为分层道路拓扑推理、地图更新和街景生成提供了宝贵来源。该数据集以及我们基准方法的代码将在 \href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git} 公开发布。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Traditional and Learning-Based Reference-Free Compressors for Long-Read Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 面向长读长测序数据的传统与基于学习的无参考压缩器基准评测
items.abstract_en: Long-read sequencing technologies generate large volumes of data, creating substantial storage and transmission demands. Although reference-based compressors can achieve high compression, their reliance on an appropriate reference genome limits their use. We present LRCBench, a benchmark and survey of reference-free lossless compressors for long-read sequencing data. We review traditional and learning-based general-purpose and sequencing-specific methods, then evaluate 35 compressors on 16 real-world datasets from Oxford Nanopore and PacBio platforms. We compare compression ratio, storage savings, runtime, peak memory use, and robustness across datasets. Learning-based compressors are evaluated on six MinION datasets because of their high computational costs. CoLoRd achieves the best overall compression ratios in our experiments, while other methods offer trade-offs in speed, memory use, and robustness. We also examine multithreaded speedup and discuss future directions in parallel acceleration, privacy protection, adaptive parameter tuning, and hardware-algorithm co-design.
items.abstract_zh: 长读长测序技术产生海量数据，带来巨大的存储与传输需求。尽管基于参考的压缩器可实现高压缩率，但其对合适参考基因组的依赖限制了其使用。我们提出 LRCBench，一个面向长读长测序数据的无参考无损压缩器基准与综述。我们回顾了传统与基于学习的通用及测序专用方法，然后在来自 Oxford Nanopore 和 PacBio 平台的 16 个真实数据集上评估了 35 个压缩器。我们比较了压缩比、存储节省、运行时间、峰值内存占用以及跨数据集的鲁棒性。由于计算成本较高，基于学习的压缩器在六个 MinION 数据集上进行评估。在我们的实验中，CoLoRd 取得最佳总体压缩比，而其他方法在速度、内存使用和鲁棒性方面提供权衡。我们还考察了多线程加速，并讨论了并行加速、隐私保护、自适应参数调优和硬件—算法协同设计的未来方向。

items.title_en: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 超越语料驱动的模仿：通过量子强化学习在智能体管弦乐团中演化音乐思维模式
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于量子强化学习和多智能体交互的计算机辅助音乐创作与演奏框架。我们引入智能体管弦乐团（agentic orchestra），其中音乐智能体通过与音乐环境的试错交互演化出各自不同的思维模式，而非通过大规模数据集训练获得。智能体以参数化量子电路实现。它们演化出不同的作曲行为，称为思维模式（mindsets）。这使在混合量子—经典回路中利用量子叠加与纠缠探索音乐决策空间成为可能。我们提出两种互补的智能体架构：原子化智能体独立处理音高与节奏，整体化智能体将音高与时值作为统一音符事件处理。思维模式通过具有音乐依据的奖励函数塑造，这些奖励函数可以组合并加权，以在不同智能体之间形成不同的思维模式。由此形成的系统将量子计算智能体定位为自适应音乐伙伴，而非自主作曲者，每个智能体通过交互而非模仿发展出自己的音乐个性。演示展示了智能体如何将学到的行为泛化到此前未见的材料，并使用 MIDI 编码音乐以交互模式和离线批量模式运行。尽管量子计算机仍在发展中，在 IBM 量子硬件上进行的实验证实，现有量子计算机可实现具有音乐意义的学习。对作曲者和演奏者而言，智能体管弦乐团为涌现式、过程导向的音乐创造力开辟了新的可能，并随着量子计算技术的持续进步，为量子计算机辅助音乐创作提供了可扩展的基础。

items.title_en: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
items.title_zh: 面向队列规模排序模型的成本感知智能体特征优化系统
items.abstract_en: Large Web platforms operate large fleets of ranking models, each selecting features from a shared pool of tens of thousands. We present an end-to-end agentic system that optimizes features across the fleet under resource constraints shared across models and those set per model, such as feature pipeline cost and serving throughput (QPS), respectively. In this system, LLM agents propose hypotheses, and deterministic tools execute experiments and verify them. For each model, an LLM generates and shortlists cross features from a combinatorial candidate space, and all features are then ranked by several importance methods. Feature blending mixes these rankings into a single selection, using Pareto fronts across tasks for multi-task models. An LLM Researcher agent then tunes the feature selection in 10--25 asynchronous trials under resource caps, and a trimming step keeps the pipeline cost within budget. Across production models, the system improves normalized entropy by 0.31% on average within each model's budget, and the trimming step cuts pipeline cost by 2.3% with no regression beyond measurement noise. The optimized models were launched, and in online A/B tests they improved a primary online metric by 0.20%.
items.abstract_zh: 大型网络平台运营着由大量排序模型组成的模型队列，每个模型从共享的数万个特征池中选择特征。我们提出一个端到端智能体系统，在模型间共享的资源约束与各模型单独设定的约束（分别为特征流水线成本与服务吞吐量 QPS）下，优化整个模型队列的特征。在该系统中，LLM 智能体提出假设，确定性工具执行实验并验证这些假设。对每个模型，LLM 从组合候选空间中生成并筛选交叉特征，随后用多种重要性方法对所有特征排序。特征混合（feature blending）将这些排序混合为单一选择，对多任务模型使用跨任务的帕累托前沿。随后，一个 LLM 研究员智能体在资源上限下通过 10–25 次异步试验调整特征选择，并通过裁剪步骤使流水线成本保持在预算内。在生产模型上，该系统在每个模型的预算内平均将归一化熵提升 0.31%，裁剪步骤使流水线成本降低 2.3%，且除测量噪声外无性能退化。优化后的模型已上线，在线 A/B 测试中其主要在线指标提升 0.20%。

items.title_en: PAIR-MED: Policy-reward Alternation for Iterative Refinement in Multilingual Medical Reasoning
items.title_zh: PAIR-MED：面向多语言医学推理迭代优化的策略—奖励交替训练
items.abstract_en: Large language models demonstrate strong medical question-answering capabilities, yet reasoning performance remains uneven across languages. Process reward models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for improving reasoning, but a fixed PRM may become increasingly misaligned with the trajectory distribution of an evolving policy during reinforcement learning, thereby reducing the reliability of its supervision. We propose a policy--reward alternating training framework that jointly adapts a medical PRM and optimizes a multilingual reasoning policy. Following supervised initialization, the current policy generates multilingual trajectories to update the PRM, which then provides process-level rewards for the next policy update. Medical step supervision maintains the PRM's medical foundation, while process, outcome, and language-related rewards guide policy learning. We develop multilingual medical PRMs (PAIR-PRM) and reasoning models (PAIR-MED) at 8B and 9B scales across 12 languages. On the medical subsets of Global-MMLU and MMLU-ProX, our models improve average accuracy by 3.01--7.47% over their corresponding Qwen backbones. On CUREMED-BENCH, PAIR-MED-9B improves the joint language consistency and logical accuracy metric by 12.88% and 7.45% over baselines for in-domain and out-of-domain languages. Further analyses examine PRM adaptation, multilingual reasoning quality, and the contributions of individual training components.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型展现出强大的医学问答能力，但推理性能在不同语言之间仍不均衡。过程奖励模型（PRM）提供步骤级反馈以改进推理，但固定的 PRM 在强化学习过程中可能与不断演化的策略的轨迹分布日益失配，从而降低其监督的可靠性。我们提出一种策略—奖励交替训练框架，联合适配医学 PRM 并优化多语言推理策略。在监督初始化之后，当前策略生成多语言轨迹以更新 PRM，PRM 再为下一次策略更新提供过程级奖励。医学步骤监督维持 PRM 的医学基础，而过程、结果和语言相关奖励引导策略学习。我们开发了 8B 和 9B 规模、覆盖 12 种语言的多语言医学 PRM（PAIR-PRM）与推理模型（PAIR-MED）。在 Global-MMLU 和 MMLU-ProX 的医学子集上，我们的模型相较对应的 Qwen 主干将平均准确率提升 3.01–7.47%。在 CUREMED-BENCH 上，PAIR-MED-9B 对域内和域外语言相较基线将联合语言一致性与逻辑准确率指标分别提升 12.88% 和 7.45%。进一步分析考察了 PRM 适配、多语言推理质量以及各训练组分的贡献。

items.title_en: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
items.title_zh: 从序列到空间：用于主动地理定位的显式空间信念与视觉—语言蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 主动地理定位（AGL）要求智能体在小型空中搜索网格中导航，并到达由航空影像、地面照片或文本指定的目标。现有方法能很好地对齐目标模态，但将导航状态保留在大型序列 Transformer 内部，并使用利用隐藏目标位置的稠密距离奖励进行训练。本文提出 EAGLE，一个用于地理定位与探索的显式空间信念智能体。离线训练从相同的随机掩蔽部分拼图出发，联合优化教师条件的 Swin 分支与无上下文的 Swin 学生。教师分支关注由 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 提取的冻结全场景上下文，两个分支均接受掩蔽单元航空特征重建与不确定性监督，而学生额外从教师蒸馏停止梯度的特征预测。蒸馏之后，Qwen、其缓存上下文以及教师注意力分支被丢弃。保留的学生仅凭部分观测预测单元级航空特征嵌入与预测不确定性。这些预测与模态对齐的目标嵌入以及由轨迹导出的访问掩码相结合，构建空间信念张量。随后冻结学生，并用 PPO 优化一个紧凑的 CNN actor-critic。EAGLE 在 MASA、xBD 零样本迁移和 MM-GAG 零样本航空目标划分上分别取得 78.1%、76.4% 和 76.8% 的最先进平均成功率，且在推理时不使用 VLM 或缓存视觉 token。代码将公开发布。

items.title_en: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
items.title_zh: DACA：用于零样本3D视觉定位的双锚点协作智能体
items.abstract_en: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
items.abstract_zh: 3D视觉定位（3D-VG）是一项连接自然语言与三维空间的任务，是具身智能与人机交互的基础能力。尽管近期的3D-VG智能体克服了对预处理三维点云的依赖，但它们本质上采用单向、流水线式的工具调用架构。该架构将语义理解与几何重建分离，导致误差累积且无法自主从失败中恢复。针对这一缺陷，本文提出双锚点协作智能体（DACA），将3D-VG重新解释为语义-几何双锚点协作推理范式。DACA由两个互补的专用工具组成：语义锚点工具保存目标的视觉语义特征，并通过光流和VLM局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚点工具保存目标的三维空间几何特征，并通过体素化和多关键点投影执行全局空间推理。两个组件通过标准化工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决定下一个感知-动作步骤，形成闭环优化。在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上的实验表明，零样本DACA在ScanRefer上取得73.6%的总体Acc@0.25，在Nr3D上取得70.4%的总体准确率，远超最新的零样本3D-VG方法。代码和模型见 https://github.com/liujia99/DACA

items.title_en: STORM: A Lightweight Structure-Free Model for Binding Affinity Prediction
items.title_zh: STORM：一种用于结合亲和力预测的轻量级无结构模型
items.abstract_en: Accurately predicting a small molecule's binding affinity to a protein, a critical task in drug discovery, remains challenging. Physics-based approaches like free-energy perturbation (FEP) have very high computational costs and require expert setup. Recent machine learning--based cofolding models have reported accuracy approaching that of FEP---and at least one of them, Boltz-2, has already been widely adopted for affinity prediction---but they remain expensive for large computational screens and even more expensive for retraining on newly collected experimental data. To address these challenges, we introduce STORM: Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules. STORM is a fast, simple machine learning model that ensembles many small model fusions of diverse protein and molecule representations for binding affinity prediction. Trained on the same data, STORM matches or exceeds the accuracy of Boltz-2 on multiple evaluation datasets, while delivering a speed improvement of over five orders of magnitude for both inference and training. Our results also suggest opportunities to substantially improve affinity prediction accuracy by integrating historical experimental affinity data with structural and biophysical information.
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测小分子与蛋白质的结合亲和力是药物发现中的关键任务，但仍具挑战性。基于物理的方法如自由能扰动（FEP）计算成本极高且需要专家设置。近期基于机器学习的共折叠模型已报告接近FEP的准确率——其中至少Boltz-2已被广泛用于亲和力预测——但它们对于大规模计算筛选仍然昂贵，并且在新收集的实验数据上重新训练甚至更昂贵。为应对这些挑战，我们提出STORM：来自观测参考分子的相似性迁移（Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules）。STORM是一种快速、简单的机器学习模型，通过集成许多由多样化蛋白质和分子表示构成的小模型融合来进行结合亲和力预测。在相同数据上训练，STORM在多个评估数据集上匹配或超过Boltz-2的准确率，同时在推理和训练上均带来超过五个数量级的速度提升。我们的结果还表明，通过将历史实验亲和力数据与结构和生物物理信息相结合，存在大幅提高亲和力预测准确率的机会。

items.title_en: Observation of room-temperature intrinsic antiferroelectricity in van der Waals NbOCl2
items.title_zh: 范德华NbOCl2中室温本征反铁电性的观测
items.abstract_en: In recent years, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectricity has been extensively investigated across a wide range of 2D materials, while intrinsic 2D antiferroelectricity remains exceptionally rare, limiting its implementation in next-generation photonic and electronic devices. Here, we report the observation of room-temperature-stable antiferroelectricity in the layered transition metal oxyhalide NbOCl2, and demonstrate a reversible, stimuli-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric (AFE-to-FE) phase transition in this material. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) mapping reveals a well-defined stripe-like spatial distribution of SHG intensity across as-grown NbOCl2 flakes spanning thickness from few-layer to bulk-like configurations. This distinctive SHG signature originates from the existence of antiferroelectric phase and the coexistence of antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases within individual crystals, as evidenced by a combined incident-angle-dependent SHG measurement and Raman spectroscopy. By integrating NbOCl2 with one-dimensional silver nanowires, we achieve spatially selective, strain-mediated AFE-to-FE phase transition. Moreover, an ultralow electric field (~20 kV/cm) induces a reversible SHG response, consistent with switching from the centrosymmetric antiferroelectric state (SHG-silent) to the non-centrosymmetric ferroelectric state (SHG-active). This study not only expands the family of room-temperature 2D antiferroelectrics but also establishes a versatile platform for dynamic manipulation of nonlinear light, paving the way toward electric-field-programmable nonlinear photonics and optical information processing.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，二维（2D）铁电性已在广泛二维材料中得到大量研究，而本征二维反铁电性仍极其罕见，限制了其在下一代光子和电子器件中的实现。在此，我们报道在层状过渡金属氧卤化物NbOCl2中观测到室温稳定的反铁电性，并演示了该材料中可逆的、刺激驱动的反铁电-铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。二次谐波产生（SHG）成像显示，在从少层到块体状构型的原生NbOCl2薄片中，SHG强度呈现清晰的条纹状空间分布。结合入射角依赖的SHG测量和拉曼光谱证明，这一独特SHG特征源于反铁电相的存在以及单个晶体中反铁电相与铁电相的共存。通过将NbOCl2与一维银纳米线集成，我们实现了空间选择性的、应变介导的AFE-to-FE相变。此外，超低电场（约20 kV/cm）诱导出可逆的SHG响应，这与从中心对称反铁电态（SHG静默）到非中心对称铁电态（SHG活跃）的切换一致。该研究不仅扩展了室温二维反铁电体家族，还建立了一个用于非线性光动态操控的多功能平台，为电场可编程非线性光子和光学信息处理铺平道路。

items.title_en: Physics-Informed Feature Representations and Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models for Generalizable Melt Pool Geometry Prediction
items.title_zh: 物理信息特征表示与预训练表格基础模型用于可泛化的熔池几何预测
items.abstract_en: Developing generalizable, data-efficient machine learning (ML) models for advanced manufacturing remains challenging because experimental datasets are limited and process-property relationships vary across materials and operating conditions. In laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), melt pool width, depth, and melting mode (conduction, transition, or keyhole) govern process stability and defect formation. Conventional ML models typically use dimensional process parameters, which represent laser-material interactions only implicitly and may limit cross-material transfer. This study evaluates whether two physics-informed dimensionless features, normalized enthalpy and Peclet number, combining laser processing conditions with material thermophysical properties, improve melt pool prediction over raw process parameters. We systematically benchmark seven models: four classical ML methods (Gaussian process, support vector machine, random forest, and XGBoost) and three pretrained tabular foundation models (TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICLv2). Experiments span 316L stainless steel, IN625, IN718, and combined-material datasets, covering regression of melt pool width and depth and classification of melting modes. Dimensionless features yield comparable or superior predictive performance in most settings, with the largest gains in cross-material depth prediction (R^2 = 0.96). Tabular foundation models generally achieve stronger classification performance than classical baselines, particularly for multi-material datasets. These findings indicate that combining physically meaningful dimensionless representations with pretrained tabular models can improve data-efficient melt pool modeling and support more transferable process-window identification in LPBF.
items.abstract_zh: 开发可泛化、数据高效的先进制造机器学习（ML）模型仍然具有挑战性，因为实验数据集有限，且工艺-性能关系随材料和操作条件而变化。在激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）中，熔池宽度、深度和熔化模式（传导、过渡或匙孔）决定工艺稳定性和缺陷形成。传统ML模型通常使用有量纲的工艺参数，这些参数仅隐式表示激光-材料相互作用，可能限制跨材料迁移。本研究评估两个物理信息无量纲特征——归一化焓和佩克莱特数——是否通过将激光加工条件与材料热物理性质结合，在熔池预测上优于原始工艺参数。我们系统地对七种模型进行基准测试：四种经典ML方法（高斯过程、支持向量机、随机森林和XGBoost）以及三种预训练表格基础模型（TabPFN、TabDPT和TabICLv2）。实验涵盖316L不锈钢、IN625、IN718和组合材料数据集，覆盖熔池宽度和深度的回归以及熔化模式的分类。无量纲特征在大多数设置下产生相当或更优的预测性能，最大增益出现在跨材料深度预测（R^2 = 0.96）。表格基础模型通常比经典基线取得更强的分类性能，尤其是在多材料数据集上。这些发现表明，将具有物理意义的无量纲表示与预训练表格模型相结合，可以改善数据高效的熔池建模，并支持LPBF中更具可迁移性的工艺窗口识别。

items.title_en: Calibrated Decision Rewards: Training Language Models with a Judge That Knows How Sure It Is
items.title_zh: 校准决策奖励：用知道自己有多确定的评判器训练语言模型
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can only teach a language model what its reward can recognize. Answer checkers are exact but need a reference answer; learned reward models and LLM judges work everywhere, but their scores are not probabilities. We study RLCDR (Reinforcement Learning from Calibrated Decision Rewards). An LLM converted into a decision model answers a typed question about a response ("is the final answer correct?", "which step is the first error?") with a probability distribution, read in one forward pass, debiased over option orders and calibrated with about a hundred labels. Training Qwen3-1.7B with GRPO on MATH, this reference-free reward raises MATH500 accuracy from 72.2% to 76.8% (+4.65 points, p < 1e-4), matching training on the answer key (76.9%), while a random reward gains only +0.65. The gain grows with difficulty, from 44.8% to 51.7% on the hardest level. On the policy's own changing samples the reward stays calibrated: its expected calibration error is half that of a softmax judge on the same 27B backbone (0.074 vs. 0.141), and it shows no sign of reward hacking. Without step training, the same model finds the first wrong step better than a dedicated 7B process reward model (ProcessBench F1 0.772 vs. 0.722, 20/20 splits). We also map where the approach stops being enough: trained only on problems the base model mostly fails, the reference-free reward still improves the policy (+1.9 MATH500 points, p = 0.03) but trails the answer key, because its probabilities become overconfident on that distribution. We state six hypotheses in advance and test each with a control designed to falsify it.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）只能教会语言模型其奖励能够识别的内容。答案核对器是精确的，但需要参考答案；学习得到的奖励模型和LLM评判器可在各处使用，但其分数不是概率。我们研究RLCDR（基于校准决策奖励的强化学习）。将LLM转换为决策模型，对关于回答的类型化问题（“最终答案是否正确？”、“哪一步是第一个错误？”）以概率分布作答，该分布在一次前向传播中读取，并针对选项顺序去偏，再用约一百个标签进行校准。在MATH上用GRPO训练Qwen3-1.7B时，这种无参考奖励将MATH500准确率从72.2%提升到76.8%（+4.65个百分点，p < 1e-4），与使用答案键训练（76.9%）相当，而随机奖励仅提升+0.65。增益随难度增加，在最难级别上从44.8%提升到51.7%。在策略自身不断变化的样本上，该奖励保持校准：其期望校准误差是相同27B骨干上softmax评判器的一半（0.074对0.141），并且没有奖励黑客迹象。无需步骤训练，同一模型在寻找第一个错误步骤方面优于专用的7B过程奖励模型（ProcessBench F1 0.772对0.722，20/20次划分）。我们还刻画了该方法何时不再足够：仅在基础模型大多失败的问题上训练时，无参考奖励仍能改进策略（+1.9 MATH500分，p = 0.03），但落后于答案键，因为其概率在该分布上变得过度自信。我们预先提出六项假设，并用旨在证伪每项假设的对照进行检验。

items.title_en: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 教VLM说什么，而非如何推理：重新思考自动驾驶中的反事实推理
items.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端自动驾驶系统已被证明存在捷径学习和因果混淆，限制了其在分布偏移下稳健泛化的能力。为缓解这些局限，近期基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的工作探索将语言推理能力纳入驾驶决策，并报告了驾驶性能的提升。特别是，反事实（CF）推理被提出以实现自我反思的高层因果理解。然而，基于语言的推理是缓解了捷径学习，还是仅将其从视觉表示转移到语言模式，从而制造因果理解的幻觉，仍不清楚。此外，现有方法常将基于干预的推理与CF推理混为一谈，使真正CF推理的效果未被探索。在本工作中，我们考察CF推理在基于VLM的自动驾驶中实际诱导了什么，并观察到它使动作分布向更保守的行为偏移，同时增加推理和决策中的不确定性。该效应在强化微调下持续存在，表明它不仅是暂时性伪影。此外，视觉注意力分析显示CF推理不改变视觉定位，而因果干预实验揭示，在事故场景中掩蔽因果相关和非因果因素会导致可比的决策变化率。总体而言，这些结果表明CF推理并未诱导基于视觉证据的真正因果推理。相反，它作为一种语言捷径重塑动作分布，教模型说什么而非如何推理，凸显了自动驾驶中基于语言的推理与因果理解之间的差距。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: SegAnyFruit: Learning Generalizable and Edge Deployable Fruit Instance Segmentation at Scale
items.title_zh: SegAnyFruit：大规模学习可泛化且可边缘部署的水果实例分割
items.abstract_en: Deploying fruit instance segmentation in real agricultural settings requires generalizing across unseen species, orchards, and imaging conditions under strict onboard compute and annotation budgets. We introduce SegAnyFruit (SAF), a data construction and progressive training framework that distills foundation-model priors into lightweight, prompt-free segmenters. SAF combines generic mask pre-training, broad mid-training on automatically annotated web imagery from our curated WebFruits dataset, and human-verified agricultural refinement post-training on PaperFruits, together spanning 733K images and 9.66M whole-fruit masks across 165 fruit types. Across seven benchmarks, zero-shot SAF-RF-DETR-XL reaches 69.06 average mask AP50:95 (+4.76 over SAM 3) while remaining deployable on edge devices. SAF initialization also boosts few-shot to full-shot adaptation across five agricultural domains while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we systematically analyze training stages, data scale, model capacity, and generative augmentation, and validate our pipeline's transferability to underwater, cell, and human segmentation. We will release our datasets, code, and SAF models.
items.abstract_zh: 在真实农业环境中部署水果实例分割，需要在严格的机载计算和标注预算下，对未见过的物种、果园和成像条件具有泛化能力。我们提出 SegAnyFruit（SAF），一种数据构建与渐进式训练框架，将基础模型先验蒸馏到轻量、无需提示的分割器中。SAF 结合了通用掩码预训练、在我们构建的 WebFruits 数据集上对自动标注网络图像进行广泛中期训练，以及在 PaperFruits 上进行经人工验证的农业细化后训练，合计涵盖 733K 图像和 9.66M 全果掩码，覆盖 165 种水果类型。在七个基准上，零样本 SAF-RF-DETR-XL 达到 69.06 的平均掩码 AP50:95（比 SAM 3 高 4.76），同时仍可部署在边缘设备上。SAF 初始化还提升了跨五个农业领域从少样本到全样本的适配能力，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。最后，我们系统分析训练阶段、数据规模、模型容量和生成式增强，并验证我们的流程可迁移到水下、细胞和人体分割。我们将发布数据集、代码和 SAF 模型。

items.title_en: Neural Circuit Architectural Priors for Rat Locomotion
items.title_zh: 用于大鼠运动的神经回路架构先验
items.abstract_en: Animals generate behavior through continuous interactions between their neural circuits, bodies, and environment. Embodied simulations study these interactions by testing neural circuit models in biologically realistic settings. Recent efforts have simulated diverse animals, and emerging work on biologically grounded neural architectures has begun to integrate circuit connectivity and single-unit dynamics from experimental data into artificial neural networks, introducing stronger inductive biases and closer mechanistic alignment with biology. How can we develop embodied simulations that enable the study of increasingly complex bodies and neural circuits? In this work, we address the challenge through coordinated advances in the simulated body, neural architecture, and training infrastructure. We introduce Rat v2, an efficient and flexible biomechanical body for simulating rat behavior. To control this body, we develop Rat NCAP, a biologically grounded neural architecture for locomotion based on mammalian spinal circuits that incorporates cell-type-specific connectivity and a novel flexor-extensor neuromechanical interface. To optimize circuit parameters, we develop GPU-accelerated simulation and training infrastructure. The model learns to locomote at different speeds and transition between gaits without imitation learning, producing locomotion statistics, kinematics, and cell-type-specific neural activity consistent with experimental data. Analyses reveal that the neuromechanical interface substantially affects trainability and gait quality, and in silico cell-type ablations reproduce known gait phenotypes and predict gait changes under graded perturbations. Together, these findings support the view that embodied simulations at an intermediate level of abstraction can simultaneously reproduce complex behavior and yield mechanistic insights into the neural circuits that generate it.
items.abstract_zh: 动物通过其神经回路、身体和环境之间的持续交互产生行为。具身仿真通过在生物逼真环境中测试神经回路模型来研究这些交互。近期工作已仿真了多种动物，而关于生物基础神经架构的新兴研究已开始将实验数据中的回路连接性和单单元动力学整合到人工神经网络中，引入更强的归纳偏置并与生物学实现更接近的机制对齐。我们如何开发能够研究日益复杂的身体和神经回路的具身仿真？在这项工作中，我们通过模拟身体、神经架构和训练基础设施的协同进展来应对这一挑战。我们提出 Rat v2，一种用于仿真大鼠行为的高效且灵活的生物力学身体。为控制该身体，我们开发 Rat NCAP，一种基于哺乳动物脊髓回路、具有生物基础的运动神经架构，其整合了细胞类型特异性连接和一种新型屈肌-伸肌神经机械接口。为优化回路参数，我们开发了 GPU 加速的仿真与训练基础设施。该模型无需模仿学习即可学习以不同速度运动并在步态之间转换，产生与实验数据一致的运动统计、运动学和细胞类型特异性神经活动。分析表明，神经机械接口显著影响可训练性和步态质量，并且计算机模拟中的细胞类型消融再现了已知步态表型，并预测了分级扰动下的步态变化。总之，这些发现支持这样的观点：处于中间抽象层次的具身仿真能够同时再现复杂行为，并对产生该行为的神经回路提供机制性见解。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 编码智能体对光学神经网络的原位训练
items.abstract_en: Optical neural networks promise fast, energy-efficient computing, but every device departs from its design and must be trained with the hardware. In situ training relies on an expert-built calibrated digital model of each device or on gradient-free trial and error. Coding agents, large language models that write and run programs, have shown an emergent ability to understand and edit the weights of digital neural networks. Here we introduce optics as code, a method in which a coding agent trains an optical neural network from measurements alone, through a harness that returns camera images of its probes and requires a hypothesis per request. We discovered that the agent forms a physical understanding of the optics and reparametrizes the network with interpretable optical elements tuned on the hardware. It outperforms gradient-free methods in classification and image encoding, approaching backpropagation through a calibrated model at a fraction of the cost. Needing neither per-device calibration nor gradients through the hardware, and improving with more capable models, optics as code offers a practical route to large, scalable optical neural networks and a general tool for calibrating and optimizing optical experiments.
items.abstract_zh: 光学神经网络有望实现快速、节能的计算，但每个器件都会偏离其设计，必须结合硬件进行训练。原位训练依赖于专家为每个器件构建的校准数字模型，或依赖于无梯度试错。编码智能体——编写并运行程序的大语言模型——已展现出理解并编辑数字神经网络权重的涌现能力。在此，我们提出“optics as code”，一种方法：编码智能体仅根据测量结果训练光学神经网络，通过一个返回其探针相机图像并要求每次请求给出假设的测试框架。我们发现，该智能体形成了对光学系统的物理理解，并用可在硬件上调节的可解释光学元件对网络重新参数化。它在分类和图像编码中优于无梯度方法，以一小部分成本接近通过校准模型的反向传播。“optics as code”既不需要逐器件校准，也不需要穿过硬件的梯度，并且会随着模型能力增强而改进，为大型、可扩展的光学神经网络提供了一条实用路径，也为校准和优化光学实验提供了一种通用工具。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对波长、器件、光路、噪声与实验条件；数值仿真不等于已制备器件或可直接部署。

items.title_en: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
items.title_zh: 注意力头特化：样本复杂度中的相变
items.abstract_en: Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. While this phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time, we ask how head specialization depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, we find that heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. We then study this phenomenon in a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention and establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. Finally, we relate these statistical transitions to the stagewise emergence of specialized heads during online learning, disentangling statistical from dynamical origins of head specialization.
items.abstract_zh: 注意力头在训练过程中特化为不同功能，通常分阶段出现，并伴随模型行为的急剧变化。尽管这一现象大多作为训练时间的函数被研究，我们追问头特化如何依赖于可用训练数据量。在经验上，我们发现 BERT 中专门处理句法关系的头会随着数据集规模增大而出现。然后，我们在一个可求解的多头注意力高维模型中研究这一现象，并确立：在该模型中，头特化是样本复杂度中的真正相变，对应于测试误差和其他可观测量中的非解析性。取决于数据结构和正则化，特化可能伴随无信息性的头分化出现，或通过一连串相变发生，逐步恢复较弱的潜在特征，从而提供一种统计形式的简单性偏置。最后，我们将这些统计相变与在线学习过程中特化头的分阶段出现联系起来，从而区分头特化的统计起源与动力学起源。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
items.title_zh: SLAM-ASR 语音识别模型的归纳头起源
items.abstract_en: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.
items.abstract_zh: 是什么使得一个从编码器状态到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的、经训练的小型映射足以实现有竞争力的语音识别？SLAM-ASR 架构的前提是，冻结的语言模型拥有足够丰富的语言知识来执行识别任务。这一假设虽然合理，却几乎没有揭示这些模型背后的机制。因此，我们寻找它们所依赖的具体内部结构。本工作表明，SLAM-ASR 模型依赖于冻结语言模型的归纳头：在文本中复制重复 token 序列的相同头，对于将语音嵌入映射到转写 token 也很重要。此外，我们发现成对的头表现为一种受约束形式的差分注意力，抵消注意力噪声并将注意力锐化到先前生成的词上。最后，我们展示如何利用归纳头在噪声音频下提升转写质量。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Assessing Vision-Language Models for Early Prediction of Unsafe Situations in Robotics
items.title_zh: 评估视觉-语言模型用于机器人不安全情境的早期预测
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information and textual instructions and, by using their ability to understand and reason about context, are well-suited for predicting robot failures before they occur. However, evidence supporting this remains limited. To address this, we present an empirical evaluation of VLMs for predicting robot failures. In particular, we experiment with Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA-OneVision across three robotic case studies (HuRoN, Pal Robotics, and CrowdBot), analyzing both video and odometry data for early failure warning (i.e., before an unsafe situation occurs). Specifically, we evaluate their performance in classifying situations as safe, potentially unsafe, and unsafe, together with uncertainty quantified using various metrics, and study the relationship between uncertainty and performance. Our results showed that Qwen provides the strongest overall classification and prediction-reliability performance, while InternVL shows stronger early-warning capability in several configurations. The results further show that the effect of robot-state information and temporal history depends on the model and evaluation objective. Overall, our findings indicate that general-purpose VLMs can support early robot-safety monitoring, but the most suitable configuration depends on whether the priority is accurate assessment of safety-state, reliable confidence and uncertainty, or timely warning before unsafe events.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）处理视觉信息和文本指令，并利用其理解和推理上下文的能力，非常适合在机器人故障发生前进行预测。然而，支持这一点的证据仍然有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出对 VLM 预测机器人故障的实证评估。具体而言，我们在三个机器人案例研究（HuRoN、Pal Robotics 和 CrowdBot）中，对 Qwen、InternVL 和 LLaVA-OneVision 进行实验，分析视频和里程计数据，以实现早期故障预警（即在不安全情境发生之前）。具体而言，我们评估它们将情境分类为安全、潜在不安全和不安全的表现，以及使用多种指标量化的不确定性，并研究不确定性与性能之间的关系。我们的结果表明，Qwen 提供了最强的整体分类和预测可靠性表现，而 InternVL 在若干配置中表现出更强的预警能力。结果进一步表明，机器人状态信息和时间历史的影响取决于模型和评估目标。总体而言，我们的发现表明，通用 VLM 可以支持早期机器人安全监测，但最合适的配置取决于优先目标是准确评估安全状态、可靠的置信度和不确定性，还是在不安全事件前及时预警。

items.title_en: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
items.title_zh: TuringPAI：面向端侧物理AI的基础模型
items.abstract_en: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.
items.abstract_zh: 物理AI需要能够在有限的端侧算力下理解空间关系与动态环境、并将观测转化为动作的模型。我们提出TuringPAI，一系列用于端侧物理AI的模型，包括用于共享视觉-语言理解的TuringPAI-VL、用于自动驾驶的TuringPAI-Drive，以及用于机器人操作的TuringPAI-Embodied。TuringPAI-VL是一个0.65B模型，构建于HybridViT-MLQ之上，后者将卷积的局部聚合与基于Transformer的全局建模相结合。多尺度潜在查询（Multi-scale Latent Queries）在同一个视觉Transformer内整合空间特征与观测历史，为语言模型提供一个紧凑、结构化的接口。训练将通用视觉-语言数据与几何、跨视角和时间监督相结合。TuringPAI-VL支持通用多模态理解，并在定量几何感知上优于Qwen2-VL-2B，同时为两个下游VLA模型提供共享初始化。在自动驾驶方面，TuringPAI-Drive使用MLQ接口，使所有评估的ADE/FDE指标与全token的HybridViT基线相比保持在1.2\%以内，并在内部仿真评估中取得可比的综合得分。在单块NVIDIA Orin-X SoC上使用XPeng Native Runtime（XNRT），TuringPAI-Drive在车载运行中以12\,Hz生成轨迹。在机器人操作方面，TuringPAI-Embodied在四个LIBERO套件上取得96.8\%的平均成功率。这些结果表明，在实际端侧约束下，存在一个可同时支持驾驶与机器人操作的共享视觉-语言基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ST-FateFlow: Continuous Gene-Spatial Reconstruction with Differentiation-Potential Learning from Time-Resolved Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: ST-FateFlow：基于时间分辨空间转录组学的连续基因-空间重建与分化潜能学习
items.abstract_en: Time-resolved spatial transcriptomics provides a powerful view of dynamic biological processes by measuring cellular states together with their spatial organization across time. However, destructive profiling and experimental cost restrict observations to a few discrete time points collected from independent samples, with no known cell pairing across time. This makes it difficult to reconstruct gene expression and tissue organization at unobserved stages and to characterize differentiation-associated dynamics. Here, we introduce ST-FateFlow, a flow-matching framework for continuous gene-spatial dynamics and differentiation-potential learning. ST-FateFlow jointly learns gene-expression and spatial-coordinate velocity fields, enabling interpolation of missing time points and continuous modeling of transcriptional evolution and tissue remodeling. In parallel, it independently learns a time-conditioned differentiation potential, whose values organize cell states along inferred differentiation progressions and support the analysis of differentiation-associated transcriptional changes. Across multiple time-resolved spatial transcriptomics datasets, ST-FateFlow effectively captures coordinated gene-expression and spatial dynamics. Case studies further show that the learned potential landscapes are consistent with known developmental and regenerative trajectories and help identify candidate genes associated with differentiation progression.
items.abstract_zh: 时间分辨空间转录组学通过测量细胞状态及其随时间的空间组织，为动态生物过程提供了强大的视角。然而，破坏性采样和实验成本将观测限制在从独立样本中采集的少数离散时间点，且跨时间没有已知的细胞配对。这使得在未观测阶段重建基因表达和组织组织方式、以及刻画分化相关动态变得困难。本文提出ST-FateFlow，一个用于连续基因-空间动态与分化潜能学习的流匹配框架。ST-FateFlow联合学习基因表达与空间坐标的速度场，从而能够插值缺失时间点，并对转录演化和组织重塑进行连续建模。与此同时，它独立学习一个时间条件化的分化潜能，其取值沿推断的分化进程组织细胞状态，并支持对分化相关转录变化的分析。在多个时间分辨空间转录组数据集上，ST-FateFlow有效捕捉了协同的基因表达与空间动态。案例研究进一步表明，所学得的潜能景观与已知的发育和再生轨迹一致，并有助于识别与分化进程相关的候选基因。

items.title_en: Fractional Charge at Dislocations from Band-Inversion Cancellation
items.title_zh: 来自能带反转相消的位错分数电荷
items.abstract_en: Band inversions with opposite Chern numbers cancel in the Hall response and yield counterpropagating boundary modes that can gap out. However, a bulk probe of the topology that survives such a cancellation is lacking. We here show that dislocations in inversion-symmetric two-band crystals with cancelling band inversions bind a half-integer charge, which reveals the quantized bulk polarization of the bond-centered obstructed atomic limit realized by such crystals. To demonstrate this, we continuously deform a broad class of two-band lattice models into decoupled chains, without closing the bulk gap or breaking the inversion symmetry, where the dislocation charge follows from a count of occupied bonds. Notably, the fractional part of this charge is insensitive to local perturbations of the dislocation core, and it therefore persists after the in-gap core state is removed, as we show analytically in the chain limit and numerically away from it. In the Weyl-semimetal counterpart, the response to a magnetic flux separates this crystalline charge from the charge set by the Chern number of each momentum slice. We propose that a half-integer core charge that persists after the in-gap peak disappears from the local spectrum can be detected in artificial electronic and optical lattices, with metamaterials providing complementary access to the core modes.
items.abstract_zh: 具有相反陈数的能带反转在霍尔响应中相互抵消，并产生可以打开能隙的反向传播边界模式。然而，对此类相消后仍然存留的拓扑，尚缺乏体探测手段。我们在此表明，在具有相消能带反转的反演对称双带晶体中，位错束缚一个半整数电荷，这揭示了此类晶体所实现的键中心阻挫原子极限的量子化体极化。为证明这一点，我们将一大类双带晶格模型连续形变为解耦链，过程中不关闭体能隙、也不破坏反演对称性；在此情形下，位错电荷可由占据键的计数得出。值得注意的是，该电荷的分数部分对位错芯的局域扰动不敏感，因此即使在能隙内芯态被移除之后仍然存在——我们在链极限下给出解析证明，并在远离该极限时给出数值验证。在外尔半金属对应情形中，对磁通的响应将这种晶格电荷与由每个动量切片的陈数所设定的电荷区分开来。我们提出，在人工电子晶格和光学晶格中可以探测到这样一种半整数芯电荷：它在能隙内峰从局域谱中消失之后仍然存在；超材料则为芯模提供了互补的探测途径。

items.title_en: LIFT: Latent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Cell Fate Dynamics with Single Cell Snapshots
items.title_zh: LIFT：基于单细胞快照的概率性细胞命运动态的潜流匹配
items.abstract_en: Lineage tracing links cell states through clonal ancestry, but does not generally identify unique source-descendant pairings. Learning from such data therefore requires a model of conditional outcomes, rather than only the terminal population distribution. We introduce LIFT, a latent flow framework for probabilistic cell-state generation from lineage-informed couplings. Variational inference encodes alternative outcomes in a latent space, while a conditional prior enables sampling from the initial state alone. A Mean Flow decoder predicts future cell state directly, requiring one decoder evaluation per sampling, which makes it convenient to predict cell fate through large scale Monte-Carlo sampling. This construction combines a representation of one-to-many relationships with efficient sampling and an analysis of conditional prediction error. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate LIFT's ability to recover both population distribution and cell fate probabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 谱系追踪通过克隆祖先关系连接细胞状态，但通常并不能唯一确定源-后代配对。因此，从此类数据中学习需要一个条件结果模型，而不仅是终末群体分布。我们提出LIFT，一个用于从谱系信息耦合生成概率性细胞状态的潜流框架。变分推断在潜在空间中编码替代结果，而条件先验使得仅从初始状态即可采样。Mean Flow解码器直接预测未来细胞状态，每次采样只需一次解码器评估，这使得通过大规模蒙特卡洛采样预测细胞命运变得便利。这一构造将一对多关系的表示与高效采样以及对条件预测误差的分析结合起来。在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，LIFT能够恢复群体分布与细胞命运概率。

items.title_en: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进协同演化的决策模型与数据
items.abstract_en: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出Piccolo，一系列多模态决策模型（0.8B至27B），通过智能体化数据工程（Agentic Data Engineering）和递归自我改进（RSI）协同演化模型能力与训练数据。这些模型对通用文本与视觉判断、智能体执行框架、数据工作流以及交互式游戏中的候选答案预测概率。Piccolo-27B以75.59分位居Decision Index Vision Full排行榜首位，Piccolo-9B和Piccolo-4B分别取得68.35和67.46。三者均在各自模型规模类别的Private基准上排名第一。研究智能体分析模型行为、构建训练数据、开展实验，并利用结果改进后续提案。语义切片和共享研究记忆将模型系列开发过程中的这些行动连接起来。训练配方包含数十万个示例，数据选择与反馈驱动的改进是自我改进过程的核心。我们的大规模RSI探索为决策模型开发带来三个反直觉洞见：（1）骨干-配方协同适配比模型的新近程度更重要：在相同配方下，较早的骨干在视觉任务上可以超越更新一代；（2）有针对性的数据整理可使4B-9B模型在专门工作流上媲美27B基线；（3）损失的持续下降可能与离散决策准确率脱钩，甚至使其退化。连同来自Data-Juicer和AgentScope生态发布的开源权重与工具，Piccolo为构建前沿决策模型和扩展数据驱动的RSI提供了可操作的蓝图。

items.title_en: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
items.title_zh: 复杂环境下空中机器人的分层机载视觉-语言-导航框架
items.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）被期望在严格的机载约束下实现语义推理、智能决策与长时程导航。尽管近期由基础模型驱动的方法在实现这一目标上已显示出有希望的进展，但现有方法仍受限于复杂环境中的3D数据可得性、轨迹可行性、长时程推理与计算效率等挑战。为弥合这些差距，我们提出VLN-AR，一个面向空中机器人的分层视觉-语言-导航（VLN）框架。VLN-AR将多模态推理与底层控制解耦，从而能够对3D位姿指令与导航意图进行结构化预测，并将其转化为动态可行的动作。为缓解数据稀缺与领域差距，我们引入一个全自动的基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的流水线，以生成可扩展的、照片级真实的无人机导航数据。渐进式三阶段训练策略进一步增强定位接地、场景推理与复杂导航能力。此外，一个轻量级认知智能体通过记忆感知的任务分解提升长时程推理能力。最后，我们设计机载优化技术，包括token稀疏化与模型轻量化，在资源受限的无人机平台上实现7.1倍–9.4倍加速，同时保持高导航性能。实验表明，该方法在仿真与真实世界无人机导航中均较现有方法有大幅提升。项目网站：https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/

items.title_en: Beyond Resemblance: Image Fusion Reimagined
items.title_zh: 超越相似性：重新构想图像融合
items.abstract_en: Image fusion often lacks ground-truth fused images, forcing existing deep methods to indirectly define fusion objectives by requiring the fused image to simultaneously resemble multiple source images. However, the distinct imaging characteristics of different modalities can impose competing constraints on the fused result, potentially limiting the effective integration of their complementary information. To address this long-standing challenge facing the image fusion community, we propose ApexFuse, a novel generative image fusion paradigm that moves beyond source-resemblance constraints toward learning a general distribution of high-quality scene representations. Specifically, we develop a human-LMM-in-the-loop pipeline that leverages large multimodal generative models and iterative human feedback to translate abstract fusion objectives into reliable visual references, thereby defining the target distribution of ideal fusion outcomes. Through target-distribution-guided adaptation, we transfer the rich generative priors of pretrained FLUX to image fusion, enabling high-quality scene reconstruction conditioned on multimodal observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ApexFuse harmoniously integrates salient thermal targets, natural colors, and fine textures, achieving superior visual quality as well as semantic segmentation and object detection performance over previous source-resemblance methods. Moreover, ApexFuse exhibits remarkable cross-task generalization, extending from infrared-visible fusion to multi-exposure fusion, multi-focus fusion, and visible-depth fusion without additional fine-tuning.
items.abstract_zh: 图像融合往往缺乏真实融合图像（ground-truth fused images），迫使现有深度方法通过要求融合图像同时类似于多幅源图像来间接定义融合目标。然而，不同模态的成像特性差异可能对融合结果施加相互竞争的约束，从而可能限制其互补信息的有效整合。为应对图像融合领域这一长期挑战，我们提出 ApexFuse，一种新的生成式图像融合范式，它超越源图像相似性约束，转向学习高质量场景表示的一般分布。具体而言，我们开发了一个 human-LMM-in-the-loop 流程，利用大型多模态生成模型和迭代式人类反馈，将抽象的融合目标转化为可靠的视觉参考，从而定义理想融合结果的目标分布。通过目标分布引导的适配，我们将预训练 FLUX 的丰富生成先验迁移至图像融合，实现以多模态观测为条件的高质量场景重建。大量实验表明，ApexFuse 和谐地整合显著热目标、自然色彩和精细纹理，相较先前的源相似性方法，在视觉质量以及语义分割和目标检测性能上取得更优表现。此外，ApexFuse 展现出显著的跨任务泛化能力，无需额外微调即可从红外-可见光融合扩展到多曝光融合、多聚焦融合和可见光-深度融合。
