items.title_en: Revealing Pathway Interactions in Network Computations with Complete Path Contribution
items.title_zh: 用完整路径贡献揭示网络计算中的路径交互
items.abstract_en: Networks pass signals through many layers of interconnected units, so explaining what they compute means tracing how information travels from input to output and how pathways interact. Most existing approaches analyze only pairwise interactions between components such as units, layers or attention heads. Even when these measurements are combined post hoc into a circuit, they do not capture higher-order interactions along full causal chains (paths) from input to output, and so cannot address how exponentially many paths interact to construct network computation. This leaves a large set of mechanistic questions unanswerable, for example whether inhibitory pathways veto excitatory ones, and how the two combine to yield network decisions. To address this gap, we introduce Complete Path Contribution, a method to decompose the network output into mathematically complete contributions of individual paths to study path-level interactions directly and at scale. Partial summation then induces definitions of contributions for any circuit at any granularity level, with completeness guaranteed at every level. We further present an efficient algorithm that identifies the $k$ strongest paths without examining all of them, with runtime empirically linear in $k$ rather than exponential in depth. By applying Path Contribution to benchmark image classification networks, we quantify excitatory-inhibitory interactions and show how they collectively construct network decisions at a level of detail previously unmeasurable. Furthermore, in an interpretable model of the mouse retina, it reveals how dynamic receptive fields emerge from excitatory-inhibitory interaction motifs among pathways between different cell types in response to time-varying natural stimuli. Overall, Path Contribution reveals how a network's causal pathways interact at scale to transform input to output.
items.abstract_zh: 网络通过多层互连单元传递信号，因此解释其计算意味着追踪信息如何从输入传播到输出以及路径如何交互。大多数现有方法仅分析单元、层或注意力头等组件之间的成对交互。即使事后将这些测量组合成电路，它们也不能捕获沿从输入到输出的完整因果链（路径）的高阶交互，因此无法处理指数级数量的路径如何交互以构建网络计算。这使大量机制性问题无法回答，例如抑制性路径是否否决兴奋性路径，以及二者如何结合以产生网络决策。为解决这一空白，我们引入完整路径贡献（Complete Path Contribution），一种将网络输出分解为各个路径在数学上完整的贡献的方法，以直接且大规模地研究路径级交互。随后，部分求和诱导出任意粒度层次上任意电路的贡献定义，并在每一层次保证完整性。我们进一步提出一种高效算法，可在不检查所有路径的情况下识别k条最强路径，其运行时间经验上随k线性，而不是随深度指数增长。通过将路径贡献应用于基准图像分类网络，我们量化兴奋-抑制交互，并展示它们如何以前所未有的细节水平共同构建网络决策。此外，在小鼠视网膜的可解释模型中，它揭示了动态感受野如何在不同细胞类型之间的路径中的兴奋-抑制交互基序响应时变自然刺激时产生。总体而言，路径贡献揭示了网络的因果路径如何大规模交互以将输入转换为输出。

items.title_en: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
items.title_zh: 重复讲述的批评：LLM时代同行评审在主张层面的同质化
items.abstract_en: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.
items.abstract_zh: 同行评审依赖于多位读者发现不同的问题。我们测量会议和期刊评审中的批评重叠。在ICLR，来自评审过程同一阶段的评审中，测得的重叠从2026年的12.0%上升到2027年的21.3%，NeurIPS、ICML以及F1000和PLOS期刊也出现逐年上升。2027年，一篇论文的第三份ICLR评审相较其他两份增加了5.46个新问题，而2026年为6.12个。我们将MELD（一种LLM生成文本检测器）应用于所有评审。在一篇论文内，被MELD标记的两份评审比两份未标记评审重叠更多：2024-2025年ICLR上多3.0个百分点，2026-2027年多4.5个百分点，五个期刊来源中多5.4个百分点。这些结果提供证据表明，同一篇论文中被LLM标记的评审彼此之间的差异性低于未被标记的评审，并提示单篇论文评审之间批评的多样性正在下降。

items.title_en: RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO
items.title_zh: RageVLA：经增强训练的感知与动作，在LIBERO上实现最先进的鲁棒性
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling. In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this view. We call this combination of Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding RageVLA. With 0.21 billion parameters, RageVLA sets a new state of the art on LIBERO-PRO among VLA policies, scoring 0.72 against 0.53 for the best published model, and a larger variant reaches 0.73. Two further tests on LIBERO-Object show that the policy acts on what it perceives. When the object positions it is given are shuffled while the camera images stay correct, its success falls from 0.965 to 0.215. When the target object is displaced by 28 cm, it still succeeds in 0.865 of the episodes, where $π_{0.5}$, run through the same harness, succeeds in 0.105.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在LIBERO上看似已饱和，然而一旦物体移动或指令要求新内容，大多数模型在LIBERO-PRO上就会失效。我们认为缺失的不是规模，而是解耦。在这些策略中，要做什么与训练时物体的位置、其周围场景以及指令措辞绑定在一起。我们在两个地方切断这些绑定。在数据中，LIBERO演示按通用规则重新排列：每个物体和固定设施都被移动和旋转，任务被迁移到其他环境和其他表面，每条指令都被改写。在策略中，一个基于冻结DINOv3特征、在此增强数据上训练的感知引擎，以解耦形式向动作模型提供场景：带有位置的对象列表，以及夹爪正在注视内容的紧凑编码，并与来自TinyCLIP的图像和指令嵌入并列。一个从头训练的流匹配扩散Transformer基于该视图进行动作。我们将这种鲁棒增强（Robust Augmentation）与接地编码（Grounded Encoding）的结合称为RageVLA。RageVLA以2.1亿参数在LIBERO-PRO的VLA策略中创下新最先进水平，得分为0.72，而最佳已发表模型为0.53，更大的变体达到0.73。在LIBERO-Object上的两项进一步测试表明，该策略依据其感知到的内容行动。当提供给它的对象位置被打乱而相机图像保持正确时，其成功率从0.965降至0.215。当目标物体位移28 cm时，它仍在0.865的情节中成功，而在相同测试框架下运行的π0.5在0.105的情节中成功。

items.title_en: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
items.title_zh: 为LLM驱动的权重空间编程训练视觉模型
items.abstract_en: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with label smoothing, gradient-based editable training, and our Edit-Ready Training (ERT), a novel method that rehearses the direct, closed-form weight edits LLMs perform. We show that preparing networks for editing raises the success of LLM edits substantially where standard networks are hard to edit. ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines. We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores. Project page: https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp
items.abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，在某些设置下，大语言模型可以执行权重空间编程，直接修改神经网络的权重。然而，目前尚不清楚对这些网络进行专门训练如何有助于权重空间编程的成功。我们提出了一个在视觉模型上进行LLM驱动权重空间编程的基准，其中五个LLM在Waterbirds、CIFAR-100、PACS和Entity-30上的重标记和错误纠正任务中编辑卷积网络和视觉Transformer。我们报告了超过2,600次此类编辑过程，每次编辑都在留出图像上针对成功、副作用和准确率损失进行评分。我们比较了标准训练、标签平滑、基于梯度的可编辑训练，以及我们的Edit-Ready Training（ERT），这是一种新方法，会演练LLM执行的直接闭式权重编辑。我们表明，在标准网络难以编辑的情况下，为编辑准备网络大幅提高了LLM编辑的成功率。ERT进一步在所有评估基线中为GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5取得最高平均得分。我们将发布我们的LLM测试框架以及所有任务、编辑轨迹和得分。项目页面：https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp

items.title_en: Sex-dependent rewarding effects of nicotine in mice are prevented by the atypical antipsychotic aripiprazole
items.title_zh: 非典型抗精神病药阿立哌唑可预防小鼠中尼古丁的性别依赖性奖赏效应
items.abstract_en: Nicotine stands amongst the most commonly used drugs in contemporary societies. Preparations for nicotine consumption range from traditional tobacco products (smoking) to modern electronic cigarettes (vaping). However, its rewarding and reinforcing effects vary as a function of dose and biological sex. In addition, few treatments exists for nicotine use disorders Here we sought to characterize the effects of nicotine on anxiety in the elevated plus maze (EPM) and reward in the conditioned place preference (CPP) paradigm in male and female mice and test the hypothesis that aripiprazole, a partial dopamine agonist, prevents nicotine-induced CPP. Nicotine effects were tested at 0.25, 0.5 and 1 mg/kg. The highest dose reduced basal locomotion in both males and females exposed to the open field and reduced open arm exploration in males in the EPM. Thus, the apparent anxiogenic-like effect is confounded by a reduction in basal exploratory activity. In the CPP paradigm, nicotine 0.5 mg/kg served as a reward conditioned stimulus in males, but not females. Finally, aripiprazole (0.1, 1 and 10 mg/kg) consistently prevented the acquisition of nicotine (0.5 mg/kg) CPP in males. These findings show a sexually dimorphic effect of nicotine in mice and suggest the antipsychotic aripiprazole as a potential pharmacological approach for reducing nicotine reward.
items.abstract_zh: 尼古丁是当代社会最常用的药物之一。尼古丁消费制品从传统烟草产品（吸烟）到现代电子烟（vaping）不等。然而，其奖赏和强化效应随剂量和生物学性别而变化。此外，尼古丁使用障碍的治疗方法很少。在此，我们试图表征尼古丁对雄性和雌性小鼠在高架十字迷宫（EPM）中焦虑以及在条件位置偏爱（CPP）范式中奖赏的影响，并检验以下假设：部分多巴胺激动剂阿立哌唑可预防尼古丁诱导的CPP。尼古丁效应在0.25、0.5和1 mg/kg剂量下测试。最高剂量降低了暴露于旷场的雄性和雌性的基础运动，并减少了雄性在EPM中的开臂探索。因此，明显的焦虑样效应被基础探索活动的降低所混杂。在CPP范式中，0.5 mg/kg尼古丁在雄性中作为奖赏条件刺激，但在雌性中不是。最后，阿立哌唑（0.1、1和10 mg/kg）在雄性中一致地预防了尼古丁（0.5 mg/kg）CPP的获得。这些发现显示了尼古丁在小鼠中的性别二态效应，并提示抗精神病药阿立哌唑作为减少尼古丁奖赏的潜在药理学方法。

items.title_en: To predict or to persist: how decoherence shapes learning in a spin-qubit quantum reservoir
items.title_zh: 预测还是持续：退相干如何塑造自旋量子比特量子储备池中的学习
items.abstract_en: In this work we investigate how dephasing and the choice of measured observables affect learning in a simulated six-qubit spin chain with Markovian dissipation and exact expectation-value readout. For externally driven nonlinear autoregressive moving-average signals, combining single- and two-qubit observables gives better predictions than a population-only readout at comparable polynomial feature counts. Most of the configurations we tested become more accurate than a reference with relaxation and dephasing disabled, most strongly at $T_2=1\,μ$s, where total memory capacity drops, and still at $T_2=5$-$10\,μ$s, where memory is only redistributed across delays. For autonomous generation, we train the readout with scheduled sampling and iterative dataset aggregation to expose it to states reached under its own feedback. We do not find a clear systematic dependence of limit-cycle persistence on coherence across the reservoir ensemble. For chaotic forecasting, in contrast, prediction horizons at $T_2=1\,μ$s shorten in all 10 reservoir realizations relative to that reference. For the noise-driven strange non-chaotic attractor, the model produces a smooth, approximately closed orbit, and neither captures the target's scatter nor follows its trajectory pointwise. We conclude that, within this simulated reservoir, the impact of coherence depends strongly on the task.
items.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究退相位和测量可观测量的选择如何影响一个具有马尔可夫耗散和精确期望值读出的模拟六量子比特自旋链中的学习。对于外部驱动的非线性自回归滑动平均信号，在相当的多项式特征数量下，结合单量子比特和双量子比特可观测量比仅布居读出给出更好的预测。我们测试的大多数配置比禁用弛豫和退相位的参考更准确，在$T_2=1\,μ$s时最强，此时总记忆容量下降；在$T_2=5$-$10\,μ$s时仍然如此，此时记忆仅在延迟间重新分布。对于自主生成，我们使用计划采样和迭代数据集聚合训练读出层，使其接触在其自身反馈下达到的状态。我们没有发现极限环持续性在储备池系综上对相干性有明确的系统性依赖。相比之下，对于混沌预测，在$T_2=1\,μ$s时，所有10个储备池实现的预测时域相对于该参考都缩短。对于噪声驱动的奇怪非混沌吸引子，模型产生平滑、近似闭合的轨道，既未捕捉目标的散布，也未逐点跟随其轨迹。我们得出结论：在这个模拟储备池中，相干性的影响强烈依赖于任务。

items.title_en: SlotFlow-GB: A Neural Framework for Trans-Dimensional Inference of Overlapping Galactic Binaries
items.title_zh: SlotFlow-GB：用于重叠银河双星跨维推断的神经网络框架
items.abstract_en: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will observe the millihertz gravitational-wave sky, including millions of long-lived Galactic binaries (GBs), tens of thousands of which are expected to be individually resolvable throughout the mission's lifetime. Extracting these sources requires jointly determining their number and physical parameters from strongly overlapping signals, posing a computationally demanding trans-dimensional inference problem. We introduce SlotFlow-GB, a neural framework that constructs a learned approximation to the trans-dimensional posterior, producing a probability distribution over source multiplicity and parameter densities for individual binaries in a single evaluation, without requiring their number to be specified in advance. We demonstrate this framework using year-long LISA simulations containing up to ten binaries within a 2 $μ$Hz frequency interval, focusing on a high-SNR regime in which source overlap, rather than individual-source detectability, is the primary challenge. The inferred source count differs from the true count by at most one in 94% of cases, while the model identifies individual binaries even when their signals overlap strongly in frequency. A complete evaluation, including parameter sampling, takes just 41 ms per band on one NVIDIA GH200 GPU, or 530 ms on eight laptop CPU threads. We further demonstrate that these distributions can be used to initialize subsequent likelihood-based inference, connecting fast amortized predictions with joint parameter estimation.
items.abstract_zh: 激光干涉空间天线（LISA）将观测毫赫兹引力波天空，包括数百万个长寿命银河双星（GB），其中数万个预计在任务寿命内可被单独分辨。提取这些源需要从强烈重叠的信号中联合确定其数量和物理参数，构成一个计算要求高的跨维推断问题。我们介绍SlotFlow-GB，一种神经网络框架，它构建跨维后验的学习近似，在单次评估中产生关于源多重性和单个双星参数密度的概率分布，而无需预先指定其数量。我们使用为期一年的LISA模拟演示该框架，模拟在2 $μ$Hz频率区间内包含最多十个双星，重点关注高信噪比区域，其中源重叠而非单个源可检测性是主要挑战。在94%的情况下，推断的源数量与真实数量相差至多一个，而模型即使在信号在频率上强烈重叠时也能识别单个双星。完整评估（包括参数采样）在单个NVIDIA GH200 GPU上每个频带仅需41 ms，或在八个笔记本电脑CPU线程上需530 ms。我们进一步证明，这些分布可用于初始化后续基于似然的推断，将快速摊销预测与联合参数估计连接起来。

items.title_en: STAGE: Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion for Weakly Supervised Cross-Tweet Event Causality Discovery
items.title_zh: STAGE：面向弱监督跨推文事件因果关系发现的时空增强图扩展
items.abstract_en: Causal relations in disaster-related social media of- ten span independent posts, making cross-tweet causal discovery difficult to supervise and model at scale. We propose STAGE, a framework that separates scalable cross-tweet weak-supervision construction from spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences. Starting from local causal seeds, STAGE retrieves semantically related event occurrences across tweets and uses a causal scorer to construct weakly labeled cross-tweet pairs. These pairs supervise a multi-head Graph Attention Network over semantically enriched event representations and a spatio- temporal context graph. We evaluate STAGE on California Wildfire and Hurricane Harvey using human-gold cross-tweet test sets and 15 baselines. Compared with local-only supervision, the constructed cross-tweet supervision improves STAGE AUPRC by 0.340 on Wildfire and 0.107 on Hurricane. STAGE achieves in-domain AUROC of 0.885 on Wildfire and 0.710 on Hurricane. Cross-disaster experiments reveal asymmetric transfer, highlighting sensitivity to dataset-specific spatio-temporal shifts. These results demonstrate the value of scalable cross-tweet supervision combined with relational event modeling for causal learning across fragmented disaster reports.
items.abstract_zh: 灾害相关社交媒体中的因果关系常常跨越独立帖子，使得跨推文因果发现难以大规模监督和建模。我们提出STAGE框架，将可扩展的跨推文弱监督构建与事件发生的时空关系学习分离。STAGE从局部因果种子出发，检索跨推文语义相关的事件发生，并使用因果评分器构建弱标注的跨推文对。这些对监督一个多头图注意力网络，该网络作用于语义丰富的事件表示和时空上下文图。我们在California Wildfire和Hurricane Harvey上使用人工金标准跨推文测试集和15个基线评估STAGE。与仅局部监督相比，构建的跨推文监督使STAGE的AUPRC在Wildfire上提高0.340，在Hurricane上提高0.107。STAGE在Wildfire上达到0.885的域内AUROC，在Hurricane上达到0.710。跨灾害实验揭示非对称迁移，突显了对数据集特定时空偏移的敏感性。这些结果证明了可扩展跨推文监督与关系事件建模相结合，在碎片化灾害报告中进行因果学习的价值。

items.title_en: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 使用深度强化学习的暴露感知信息路径规划
items.abstract_en: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints. We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究一组移动传感智能体的有限预算暴露感知信息路径规划（IPP）问题。智能体在限制暴露于高场强度的同时，绘制未知标量场。现有IPP方法在运动或资源约束下优化信息量，但未处理场暴露约束。我们将暴露感知IPP（EA-IPP）表述为标量化双目标信念状态马尔可夫决策过程，在归一化高斯过程（GP）信息增益与归一化测量导出的机群暴露指数之间进行权衡。采用参数共享的近端策略优化（PPO）框架，具有去中心化执行器和集中式机群评论家，离线训练并在未见过的场上评估。在雷达、羽流和野火场族中，EA-IPP智能体在所评估基线中取得最低的GP重建RMSE，同时将D-最优信息保持在非学习信息基线的10%以内。对于雷达、羽流和野火，最小场暴露分别比非暴露感知基线低约34.6%、20.1%和27%。

items.title_en: Fast Self-Supervised Generative CT Denoising via Few-Step Sampling
items.title_zh: 基于少步采样的快速自监督生成式CT去噪
items.abstract_en: Low-dose and thin-slice computed tomography (CT) images suffer from elevated noise that obscures anatomical detail, while clean references for supervised denoising are often unavailable. Although Noise2Noise permits self-supervised training from noisy pairs, direct regression tends to oversmooth fine structure. Averaging multiple independently generated samples mitigates this blur, though repeating multi-step diffusion sampling is costly. We introduce Noise2Noise with Improved Mean Flow (N2N-iMF) to accelerate this process via few-step sampling. N2N-iMF learns to generate one noisy image conditioned on its paired counterpart; at inference, independent outputs are sampled and averaged to suppress noise. We evaluated image quality and sampling efficiency on simulated thin-slice brain and low-dose abdominal CT across four sampling methods and averaging counts from 1 to 20, and validated the approach on real-world photon-counting CT (PCCT) brain scans. With ten samples per conditioning input and three network evaluations per sample, N2N-iMF achieved a mean absolute error of 2.60 HU on brain CT and 14.02 HU on abdominal CT, outperforming 50-evaluation denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) sampling (2.91 and 14.53 HU). On the same GPU, per-output generation time dropped from 7.29 to 0.43 s. Across eight PCCT cases, N2N-iMF reached a mean gray-white matter contrast-to-noise ratio of 1.341, versus 0.916 for Noise2Noise and 1.176 for DDIM. N2N-iMF accelerates self-supervised generative CT denoising without distillation while keeping the number of averaged outputs adjustable at inference.
items.abstract_zh: 低剂量和薄层计算机断层扫描（CT）图像噪声升高，会遮蔽解剖细节，而监督式去噪所需的干净参考图像往往不可获得。尽管Noise2Noise允许利用噪声图像对进行自监督训练，但直接回归倾向于过度平滑精细结构。对多个独立生成的样本取平均可缓解这种模糊，但重复进行多步扩散采样代价高昂。我们提出改进平均流噪声2噪声（Noise2Noise with Improved Mean Flow, N2N-iMF），通过少步采样加速这一过程。N2N-iMF学习以其配对图像为条件生成一幅噪声图像；在推理时，对独立输出采样并取平均以抑制噪声。我们在模拟薄层脑CT和低剂量腹部CT上，跨四种采样方法和1至20的取平均次数评估图像质量与采样效率，并在真实光子计数CT（PCCT）脑扫描上验证该方法。每个条件输入使用十个样本、每个样本进行三次网络评估时，N2N-iMF在脑CT和腹部CT上分别达到2.60 HU和14.02 HU的平均绝对误差，优于进行50次评估的去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）采样（2.91 HU和14.53 HU）。在同一GPU上，每个输出的生成时间从7.29 s降至0.43 s。在八个PCCT病例中，N2N-iMF达到平均灰白质对比噪声比1.341，而Noise2Noise为0.916，DDIM为1.176。N2N-iMF无需蒸馏即可加速自监督生成式CT去噪，同时在推理时保持平均输出数量可调。

items.title_en: Treg- and CD8-Specific PD-1 Deficiency Reveals That CD8⁺ T Cell-Intrinsic Signaling Uniquely Restrains Pressure Overload Inflammation and Heart Failure
items.title_zh: Treg与CD8特异性PD-1缺失揭示CD8⁺ T细胞内在信号独特地抑制压力超负荷炎症和心力衰竭
items.abstract_en: Aims: PD-1 signaling limits cardiac remodeling and heart failure (HF). Whether this protection depends on PD-1 signaling intrinsic to CD8 T cells or on regulation by other immune populations, including regulatory T cells (Tregs), remains unclear. Methods and results: Using transverse aortic constriction (TAC), we studied global PD-1-knockout (KO) mice with or without CD8 T cell depletion, CD8 T cell-specific (PD1KOCD8), and Treg-specific PD-1-KO mice. We assessed left ventricular (LV) remodeling, genomic profiles, immune infiltration, and the therapeutic impact of C-X-C motif chemokine receptor 3 (CXCR3) blockade. CD8 T cell depletion abolished TAC-induced left ventricular (LV) hypertrophy, fibrosis, and dysfunction of global PD-1-KO mice. PD1KOCD8 mice had normal baseline cardiac function but, after TAC, showed reduced survival, worse LV dysfunction and fibrosis, and greater immune cell infiltration. CD8 T cells from PD1KOCD8 mice showed increased activation and proliferation, with increased production of cytotoxic molecules, such as IFN-{gamma} and granzyme A, both at baseline and after TAC. Post-TAC transcriptomics revealed enhanced inflammatory pathways and suppressed metabolic pathways in PD1KOCD8 hearts. TAC also increased LV CXCR3+CD8+ T cell accumulation and CXCL9/CXCL10 expression in PD1KOCD8 mice. CXCR3 neutralizing antibody treatment reduced LV CD8+ T cell accumulation and attenuated cardiac dysfunction. In contrast, Treg-specific PD-1 deficiency did not alter baseline or TAC-induced cardiac remodeling. Conclusions: CD8 T cell-intrinsic PD-1 restrains TAC-induced HF, whereas Treg-intrinsic PD-1 is dispensable. CXCR3-dependent recruitment drives pathological CD8 T cell accumulation, identifying PD-1/CXCR3 axis as a key regulator of CD8 T cell-mediated cardiac injury.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：PD-1信号限制心脏重塑和心力衰竭（HF）。这种保护作用取决于CD8 T细胞内在的PD-1信号，还是取决于其他免疫群体（包括调节性T细胞（Treg））的调控，仍不清楚。方法与结果：采用横向主动脉缩窄（TAC），我们研究了全身PD-1敲除（KO）小鼠（伴或不伴CD8 T细胞清除）、CD8 T细胞特异性PD-1敲除（PD1KOCD8）小鼠和Treg特异性PD-1敲除小鼠。我们评估了左心室（LV）重塑、基因组谱、免疫浸润以及C-X-C趋化因子受体3（CXCR3）阻断的治疗影响。CD8 T细胞清除消除了全身PD-1-KO小鼠中TAC诱导的LV肥厚、纤维化和功能障碍。PD1KOCD8小鼠基线心功能正常，但在TAC后表现出生存率降低、LV功能障碍和纤维化更严重以及免疫细胞浸润增加。来自PD1KOCD8小鼠的CD8 T细胞在基线和TAC后均表现出活化和增殖增加，并产生更多细胞毒性分子，如IFN-γ和颗粒酶A。TAC后转录组学显示，PD1KOCD8心脏中炎症通路增强、代谢通路受抑制。TAC还增加了PD1KOCD8小鼠LV中CXCR3⁺CD8⁺ T细胞积聚以及CXCL9/CXCL10表达。CXCR3中和抗体治疗减少了LV CD8⁺ T细胞积聚并减轻了心脏功能障碍。相反，Treg特异性PD-1缺失未改变基线或TAC诱导的心脏重塑。结论：CD8 T细胞内在的PD-1限制TAC诱导的HF，而Treg内在的PD-1并非必需。CXCR3依赖性募集驱动病理性CD8 T细胞积聚，表明PD-1/CXCR3轴是CD8 T细胞介导心脏损伤的关键调控因子。

items.title_en: Alloying effects on the interface cohesion of grain boundaries in the Ni--Fe--Cr system
items.title_zh: 合金化对Ni–Fe–Cr系晶界界面内聚的影响
items.abstract_en: Grain boundaries (GBs) in polycrystalline Ni-based alloys strongly influence mechanical strength and fracture behavior, yet the effect of alloying elements such as Fe and Cr on GB cohesion remains difficult to quantify systematically. Using density functional theory (DFT), we compute rigid-body separation (RBS) curves for six symmetric-tilt Ni GBs, extracting the work of separation $W_{\mathrm{sep}}$ and maximum traction $σ_{\max}$ via the universal binding energy relation (UBER). We find that substitution of Cr or Fe into the GB plane increases both quantities relative to pure Ni GBs. To overcome the size limitations of DFT, we compare several machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models against the DFT dataset and identify a model achieving quantitative agreement with DFT for $W_{\mathrm{sep}}$ and $σ_{\max}$. This MLIP enables systematic sampling of alloying configurations at finer concentration steps. We show that alloying-induced changes in GB cohesion depend on both, element type and local structures, revealing trends that are inaccessible with DFT alone. Extending the analysis to a ternary $\mathrm{Ni}_{56}\mathrm{Fe}_{20}\mathrm{Cr}_{24}$ composition, inspired by the principal constituents of the widely used commercial Alloy 718, shows that the binary trends provide a useful basis for interpreting the combined effect of both substitutes, while explicit ternary calculations are required to capture their interplay quantitatively. Together, these results provide a validated workflow for quantifying the effect of alloying elements on GB cohesion in multicomponent alloys. The resulting values may serve as input for continuum-scale fracture models, paving the way toward atomistically informed multiscale modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 多晶镍基合金中的晶界（GBs）强烈影响力学强度和断裂行为，但Fe和Cr等合金元素对晶界内聚的影响仍难以系统量化。我们使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算六个对称倾转Ni晶界的刚体分离（RBS）曲线，并通过通用结合能关系（UBER）提取分离功W_sep和最大牵引力σ_max。我们发现，相对于纯Ni晶界，将Cr或Fe置换到晶界平面会提高这两个量。为克服DFT的尺寸限制，我们将若干机器学习原子间势（MLIP）基础模型与DFT数据集进行比较，并确定一个在W_sep和σ_max上与DFT达到定量一致的模型。该MLIP能够以更细的浓度步长系统采样合金化构型。我们表明，合金化引起的晶界内聚变化同时取决于元素类型和局部结构，揭示了仅靠DFT无法获得的趋势。将分析扩展到三元Ni56Fe20Cr24成分（受广泛使用的商用合金718主要 constituent 启发），表明二元趋势为解释两种替代元素的联合效应提供了有用基础，而定量捕捉其相互作用仍需显式三元计算。总之，这些结果为量化多组分合金中合金元素对晶界内聚的影响提供了经过验证的工作流程。所得数值可作为连续尺度断裂模型的输入，为原子尺度信息驱动的多尺度建模铺平道路。

items.title_en: 20 ghz longitudinal surface acoustic wave resonators in 100-nm x-cut lithium niobate on silicon carbide
items.title_zh: 碳化硅上100 nm X切铌酸锂中的20 GHz纵波声表面波谐振器
items.abstract_en: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonators above 15~GHz require a fast acoustic mode that retains strong electromechanical coupling ($k^2$). This work reports longitudinal SAW (L-SAW) resonators designed for high $k^2$ in 100-nm X-cut lithium niobate (LN) on 4H silicon carbide (SiC), operating up to 21.7~GHz and reaching a $k^2$ of 8.1\%, a maximum Bode $Q$ of 70, and a figure of merit (FoM) of 5.7 at 20.24~GHz. In this thin-film waveguide, shrinking the wavelength ($λ$) keeps the normalized LN thickness ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$) large, sustaining both $k^2$ and acoustic confinement. Conversely, increasing $λ$ from 292 to 471~nm lowers $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ from 0.34 to 0.21 and raises the L-SAW phase velocity from 6.32 to 7.05~km/s, within 1.1\% of the 7126-m/s shear-wave velocity of 4H-SiC. As the velocity approaches this limit, more of the acoustic energy spreads into the non-piezoelectric SiC, and $k^2$ falls from its 8.1\% peak at $λ= 322$~nm to 1.7\% at $λ= 471$~nm. No L-SAW resonance is observed for $λ\geq 518$~nm ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ\leq 0.19$), where the mode becomes leaky. Overall, the FoM stays within 5\% of its maximum for $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ between 0.26 to 0.31, defining a design window for L-SAW resonators in thin LN on SiC at K-band and beyond.
items.abstract_zh: 15 GHz以上的声表面波（SAW）谐振器需要一种快速声学模式，同时保持强机电耦合（k^2）。本工作报道了在4H碳化硅（SiC）上的100 nm X切铌酸锂（LN）中为高k^2设计的纵波SAW（L-SAW）谐振器，其工作频率高达21.7 GHz，并在20.24 GHz处达到8.1%的k^2、70的最大Bode Q和5.7的品质因数（FoM）。在这种薄膜波导中，缩小波长（λ）可使归一化LN厚度（h_LN/λ）保持较大，从而维持k^2和声学约束。相反，将λ从292 nm增大到471 nm会使h_LN/λ从0.34降至0.21，并将L-SAW相速度从6.32 km/s提高到7.05 km/s，与4H-SiC的7126 m/s剪切波速度相差在1.1%以内。随着速度接近该极限，更多声能扩散到非压电的SiC中，k^2从λ=322 nm处的8.1%峰值降至λ=471 nm处的1.7%。对于λ≥518 nm（h_LN/λ≤0.19），未观察到L-SAW共振，此时模式变为泄漏模式。总体而言，当h_LN/λ在0.26至0.31之间时，FoM保持在其最大值的5%以内，这为SiC上薄LN中K波段及更高频段的L-SAW谐振器定义了一个设计窗口。

items.title_en: FoodReact-AR: Learning Audience Reactions that Zero-Shot LLMs Miss in Arabic Food-Insecurity Discourse
items.title_zh: FoodReact-AR：学习零样本LLM在阿拉伯语粮食不安全话语中错过的受众反应
items.abstract_en: Facebook reactions record how an audience received a post, a signal absent from the post's text. We treat the six differentiated reactions on 74,241 Arabic food-insecurity posts from public Facebook pages (2020-2024) as compositions, apply a centered log-ratio transformation, and cluster them into four audience profiles: Solidarity (Love-dominant), Dismissal (Haha-dominant), Grief (Sad-dominant), and a flat Ambivalent profile. Dismissal peaks in 2022 (22.3%), the year of the wheat price shock, and grief in 2024 (14.0%), during the Gaza food emergency; a page-clustered GEE confirms both shifts (odds ratios 2.18 and 1.34), and they survive minimum-reaction filtering, alternative zero replacements and clustering methods, and bootstrap resampling. We then test whether the profiles can be predicted without reactions. A zero-shot Arabic LLM recovers Grief for 83.8% of posts but Dismissal for only 3.4%, and in a matched ablation, it shows the reaction percentages do not help. A simple classifier trained on the reaction-derived labels and tested on unseen pages recovers dismissal for 60.0% (macro-F1 0.56 against 0.43), mainly from mentions of officials and institutions. Derisive audience responses are thus learnable from text, yet a zero-shot LLM misses them. We release the corpus, LLM, and human annotation layers, and an evaluation protocol as FoodReact-AR.
items.abstract_zh: Facebook反应记录了受众如何接收帖子，这是帖子文本中不存在的信号。我们将来自公共Facebook页面（2020-2024年）的74,241条阿拉伯语粮食不安全帖子上的六种差异化反应视为成分数据，应用中心对数比变换，并将其聚类为四种受众画像：团结（Love主导）、轻蔑（Haha主导）、悲伤（Sad主导）以及一个平坦的矛盾（Ambivalent）画像。轻蔑在2022年达到峰值（22.3%），即小麦价格冲击之年；悲伤在2024年达到峰值（14.0%），即加沙粮食紧急情况期间；按页面聚类的GEE证实了这两次变化（优势比2.18和1.34），并且它们在最小反应过滤、替代零值替换和聚类方法以及bootstrap重采样下仍然存在。然后，我们测试是否可以在没有反应的情况下预测这些画像。一个零样本阿拉伯语LLM对83.8%的帖子恢复了悲伤，但仅对3.4%的帖子恢复了轻蔑，并且在匹配的消融实验中，它表明反应百分比没有帮助。一个简单的分类器在反应衍生标签上训练，并在未见过的页面上测试，对轻蔑的恢复率为60.0%（macro-F1为0.56，对比0.43），主要来自对官员和机构的提及。因此，嘲弄性的受众反应可以从文本中学习，但零样本LLM错过了它们。我们发布了语料库、LLM和人工标注层，以及一个评估协议，作为FoodReact-AR。

items.title_en: Learning-Based System Identification for DVL-Constrained AUV Localization
items.title_zh: 基于学习的系统辨识用于DVL约束的AUV定位
items.abstract_en: Nowadays, most AUVs utilize Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) and inertial measurement units (IMUs) to achieve satisfactory dead-reckoning results. However, the DVL bottom lock may not be available in some scenarios, such as moving over a soft bottom or traveling further away from the seafloor beyond the DVL's range. As a result, the localization system solely reliant on the IMU data will experience significant drift. The relatively high cost of DVLs also inhibits multirobot or swarm operations. In this article, we present the results of using fully connected feedforward neural networks to predict vehicle velocity (surge, sway, and heave) for AUV localization. Approximation functions for the vehicle velocities are derived based on the generalized six degree-of-freedom dynamic equation and kinematics, proving that they are suitable for feedforward neural networks with measurable inputs. The neural networks are trained using field data collected using an AUV. An ablation study was conducted to investigate the impacts of hyperparameters, and the most effective models were selected using the Akaike information criterion. The selected neural network models are tested on three new sets of mission data collected on two different days. The quantitative results show that localization using vehicle velocities predicted by neural networks yields lower averaged root-mean-square distance errors and standard deviation compared to the DVL-aided dead-reckoning method. However, the extent of this improvement was found to depend on ocean current conditions. The promising results show that lightweight fully connected feedforward neural networks offer an attractive approach for inertial-based underwater localization when DVLs or their measurements are not available.
items.abstract_zh: 如今，大多数AUV利用多普勒速度计（DVL）和惯性测量单元（IMU）来获得令人满意的航位推算结果。然而，在某些场景下DVL底跟踪锁定可能不可用，例如在软海底上方移动或远离海底超出DVL作用范围。因此，仅依赖IMU数据的定位系统将经历显著漂移。DVL相对较高的成本也阻碍了多机器人或集群作业。本文给出了使用全连接前馈神经网络预测AUV定位所需载体速度（纵荡、横荡和垂荡）的结果。基于广义六自由度动力学方程和运动学推导了载体速度的近似函数，证明其适用于具有可测量输入的前馈神经网络。神经网络使用AUV采集的现场数据进行训练。进行了消融研究以考察超参数的影响，并使用赤池信息准则选择最有效的模型。所选神经网络模型在两个不同日期采集的三组新任务数据上进行了测试。定量结果表明，与DVL辅助航位推算方法相比，使用神经网络预测的载体速度进行定位可获得更低的平均均方根距离误差和标准差。然而，这种改进的程度取决于海流条件。这些有希望的结果表明，当DVL或其测量不可用时，轻量级全连接前馈神经网络为基于惯性的水下定位提供了一种有吸引力的方法。

items.title_en: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
items.title_zh: 修正孪生，而非检测器：基于数字孪生数据的仿真到真实路侧LiDAR检测
items.abstract_en: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.
items.abstract_zh: 路侧LiDAR检测器使用真实标签训练成本高昂，数字孪生有望替代这些标签，但在孪生上训练的检测器在真实场地会遇到不同的传感器、不同的物体和不同的标注惯例。我们描述了在UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge（IEEE BigData 2026 Cup）LUMPI赛道获得第一名（综合得分0.5541）、在其V2X-Real赛道获得第五名（0.8102）的流程。每个检测器都是仅使用合成数据训练的CenterPoint模型，运行在单块8 GB笔记本电脑GPU上。大部分收益来自修正孪生与真实场地之间的差异，而不是来自检测器。我们将孪生的坐标、点密度和边界框约定与测试传感器对齐，生成孪生中缺失的行人和骑行者，并加入街道杂物作为未标注负样本，同时按真实尺寸和真实点密度重建孪生对象。一种非学习的重采样方法，将未标注真实帧的逐单元点密度作为目标，使LUMPI真实感从0.589提升到0.947，而真实帧之间为0.949。随后，无标签后处理利用了固定路侧传感器所保证的特性：静态结构在每一帧中反复出现，真实物体具有特征性的点统计。并排报告每个组件在验证集和测试集上的增益时，我们发现，对系统性仿真到真实差异的修正能够迁移到测试集，通常保留其验证增益的四分之一到四分之三，而拟合验证集中少量物体的选择则不能。

items.title_en: Autoinhibition and conformational activation regulate cell-wall anchoring of the bacterial type IV pilus machinery
items.title_zh: 自抑制与构象激活调控细菌IV型菌毛机器的细胞壁锚定
items.abstract_en: Type IV pili are widespread bacterial nanomachines that mediate adhesion, motility and host interactions, yet the molecular mechanism coordinating assembly of their outer-membrane channel with attachment to the bacterial cell wall has remained unknown. Here, we show that the conserved PilQ-associated protein TsaP functions as a conformationally regulated envelope adaptor linking secretin assembly to cell-wall anchoring. A crystal structure of full-length TsaP, integrated with structural, biophysical and functional analyses, reveals a compact autoinhibited conformation in which the N-terminal LysM domain is sequestered against the protein core. Comparative structural analyses support a mechanism in which PilQ association remodels TsaP, exposing the LysM domain for peptidoglycan binding. Together, our findings support a mechanistic model in which PilQ-dependent conformational activation of TsaP couples secretin assembly to cell-wall anchoring, providing a framework for understanding the regulated integration of type IV pilus machineries within the bacterial envelope.
items.abstract_zh: IV型菌毛是广泛存在的细菌纳米机器，介导黏附、运动和宿主相互作用，但协调其外膜通道组装与附着到细菌细胞壁的分子机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，保守的PilQ相关蛋白TsaP作为受构象调控的包膜衔接蛋白，将secretin组装与细胞壁锚定连接起来。全长TsaP的晶体结构，结合结构、生物物理和功能分析，揭示了一种紧凑的自抑制构象，其中N端LysM结构域被隔离在蛋白核心上。比较结构分析支持一种机制：PilQ结合重塑TsaP，暴露LysM结构域以供肽聚糖结合。总之，我们的发现支持一个机制模型，其中TsaP的PilQ依赖性构象激活将secretin组装与细胞壁锚定偶联，为理解IV型菌毛机器在细菌包膜内的受调控整合提供了框架。

items.title_en: A Quantum Genetic Algorithm for Optimization of Benchmark Test Functions using Entangled Qutrits
items.title_zh: 使用纠缠qutrit的基准测试函数优化量子遗传算法
items.abstract_en: Typically, quantum genetic algorithms are based on qubits, a two-level quantum system. This work investigates the optimization of Rastrigin, Rosen-Brock and Table Holder Function in comparison with Classical Genetic Algorithm (CGA), using two quantum approaches: Quantum Genetic Algorithm (QGA), and Higher-Order Quantum Genetic Algorithm (HO-QGA) based on qutrits, a three-level system. HO-QGA uses higher-dimensional quantum representations, such as entangled qutrits, to test its capability of enhanced optimization. We show that the QGA convergence rate is higher than the CGA, and the solution quality is considerably improved. Based on this study, a three-state quantum object novelly provides more capabilities than qubits in terms of computational and information resources.
items.abstract_zh: 通常，量子遗传算法基于量子比特，即二能级量子系统。本工作使用两种量子方法：量子遗传算法（QGA）和基于qutrit（三能级系统）的高阶量子遗传算法（HO-QGA），与经典遗传算法（CGA）相比，研究Rastrigin、Rosen-Brock和Table Holder函数的优化。HO-QGA使用更高维的量子表示，例如纠缠qutrit，以检验其增强优化的能力。我们表明，QGA的收敛速率高于CGA，解的质量显著提高。基于这项研究，一种三态量子对象在计算和信息资源方面新颖地提供了比量子比特更多的能力。

items.title_en: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
items.title_zh: TideCache：具有透明缓存管理和逐层流式传输的高效混合LLM服务
items.abstract_en: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual addresses, preserving cache layouts and backend interfaces. The Cache Streamer uses computation intervals provided by bounded-state layers to prefetch the next global-attention layer's prefix into GPU slots shared across global-attention layers, reducing GPU residency while overlapping layer-wise transfers with computation. Generated KV remains resident. The Request Scheduler selects resident or streamed execution and triggers capacity adjustments according to request size and queue state. Together, they let HBM released by streaming accommodate other cache components and additional requests. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on GB300 and GH200 across seven model/platform configurations, TideCache completes up to 2.04x as many agent turns, reduces overall P50 per-token latency by 20--59%, and improves agent P50 TTFT by 1.40--3.05x compared with SGLang with HiCache.
items.abstract_zh: 混合架构已成为开放权重语言模型中的主流。其全局注意力和有界状态层维护异构缓存，这些缓存的需求随上下文长度和并发度而变化。我们提出TideCache，一个在CPU-GPU超级芯片上的服务系统，包含三个组件，用于在缓存之间分配GPU内存并管理它们在GPU和主机内存之间的驻留。透明缓存池在固定虚拟地址背后在缓存组件之间重新分配物理页，从而保持缓存布局和后端接口。缓存流式器利用有界状态层提供的计算间隔，将下一个全局注意力层的前缀预取到跨全局注意力层共享的GPU槽中，从而减少GPU驻留，同时将逐层传输与计算重叠。生成的KV保持驻留。请求调度器根据请求大小和队列状态选择驻留执行或流式执行，并触发容量调整。它们共同使通过流式传输释放的HBM能够容纳其他缓存组件和额外请求。TideCache在SGLang中实现，并在GB300和GH200上跨七种模型/平台配置进行评估，与使用HiCache的SGLang相比，最多完成2.04倍的智能体轮次，将总体P50每token延迟降低20--59%，并将智能体P50 TTFT提高1.40--3.05倍。

items.title_en: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 自由遗忘，稍后 Grep：面向长时程 LLM 智能体的无损、无索引记忆
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents often exceed their context windows, forcing them to discard information that may be needed later. Existing context management strategies rely on summarization, masking, or structured memory, requiring decisions about what to preserve or how to retrieve it before future needs are known. However, these methods can introduce lossy compression, potentially discarding details needed for future tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce GrepMem, a simple, lossless, and index-free memory mechanism built on two components: an append-only plain-text log of the agent's complete history and a regular-expression search tool for on-demand recall. Unlike structured memory systems, GrepMem requires no embeddings, retrieval index, memory extraction, or additional models. We train Qwen3.5-9B with reinforcement learning under five context management strategies and evaluate on multi-question research sessions, long-stream recall, and agent-trajectory question answering. GrepMem achieves 95-97% accuracy on ContextBench, versus at most 21% for lossy baselines, and outperforms SUPO's summarization by 8.8 percentage points on BCP-Multi. GrepMem scales effectively to increasingly long input streams while remaining on the accuracy-token-cost Pareto frontier across all five evaluation tasks. Our results show that a plain-text log and grep provide a simple but competitive approach to long-horizon agent memory, without requiring complex structured memory infrastructure.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程 LLM 智能体常超出其上下文窗口，迫使它们丢弃之后可能需要的信息。现有上下文管理策略依赖摘要、掩蔽或结构化记忆，需要在对未来需求尚不知晓时决定保留什么或如何检索。然而，这些方法可能引入有损压缩，可能丢弃未来任务所需的细节。为解决这一局限，我们引入 GrepMem，一种简单、无损且无索引的记忆机制，基于两个组件构建：智能体完整历史的仅追加纯文本日志，以及用于按需回忆的正则表达式搜索工具。与结构化记忆系统不同，GrepMem 不需要嵌入、检索索引、记忆提取或额外模型。我们在五种上下文管理策略下用强化学习训练 Qwen3.5-9B，并在多问题研究会话、长流回忆和智能体轨迹问答上评估。GrepMem 在 ContextBench 上达到 95-97% 准确率，而有损基线最多为 21%，并在 BCP-Multi 上比 SUPO 的摘要方法高出 8.8 个百分点。GrepMem 能有效扩展到越来越长的输入流，同时在所有五个评估任务中保持在准确率-令牌成本帕累托前沿上。我们的结果表明，纯文本日志加 grep 为长时程智能体记忆提供了一种简单但有竞争力的方法，且不需要复杂的结构化记忆基础设施。

items.title_en: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
items.title_zh: 从自博弈强化学习到约束控制：用DAgger蒸馏DiffMPC学生
items.abstract_en: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.
items.abstract_zh: 自博弈强化学习（RL）可产生强大的驾驶策略，但这些策略难以验证或解释。可微模型预测控制（DiffMPC）可以施加显式约束，但通常通过模仿日志数据或使用昂贵的RL来训练。为了给已经训练好的策略添加约束，我们保留PPO教师的骨干网络，并将其动作头替换为DiffMPC，该DiffMPC施加道路边界半平面和智能体椭圆约束。然后，我们在教师的自博弈模拟器中用DAgger蒸馏学生。在9个随机种子上，较小教师的受约束学生在nuPlan上与其教师匹敌，并在CARLA和分布外Waymo场景上击败教师。对于更强的教师，学生在nuPlan和Waymo上失败更少，而在CARLA上保持持平。其蒸馏耗时不超过教师训练时间的30%。

items.title_en: What's in the box? Revealing Object Layouts Inside Opaque Boxes via Contactless Vibration Excitation and Sensing
items.title_zh: 盒子里有什么？通过非接触式振动激励与传感揭示不透明盒子内部的物体布局
items.abstract_en: Can we reveal what is inside an opaque box by observing its surface vibrations? Objects inside a box alter its mechanical response, providing cues about their hidden locations. We introduce a method that uses these cues to predict a box's 2D occupancy layout entirely remotely. A nearby speaker excites vibrations, which we measure on one visible wall using a grid of laser points and a camera measuring each point's speckle-pattern shifts. Our model, WhisperBox, learns to encode these vibrations into a latent representation and decode it into an occupancy map of the box's contents. The method requires no physical contact to excite or sense vibrations. We demonstrate layout recovery across various boxes and single- and multiple-object scenes, with generalization to unseen object instances, positions, orientations, and weights, as well as changes in laser placement and excitation source. Our analysis reveals that informative frequency bands need not coincide with the box's resonances and that the learned latent space captures object placement and supports arithmetic operations. These results demonstrate the potential of remote vibration sensing to infer spatial layouts hidden from view.
items.abstract_zh: 我们能否通过观察不透明盒子的表面振动来揭示其内部物体？盒子内的物体会改变其机械响应，从而提供有关其隐藏位置的线索。我们提出一种方法，利用这些线索完全远程地预测盒子的二维占用布局。附近的扬声器激发振动，我们使用激光点网格和相机测量每个点的散斑图案偏移，在一个可见壁上测量这些振动。我们的模型 WhisperBox 学习将这些振动编码为潜在表示，并将其解码为盒子内容的占用图。该方法无需物理接触即可激励或感测振动。我们展示了在各种盒子以及单物体和多物体场景中的布局恢复，并泛化到未见过的物体实例、位置、方向和重量，以及激光放置和激励源的变化。我们的分析表明，信息丰富的频段不必与盒子的共振重合，并且学习到的潜在空间捕获了物体放置并支持算术运算。这些结果展示了远程振动传感在推断视野外隐藏空间布局方面的潜力。

items.title_en: 2-hydroxyglutarate-dependent inhibition of TET2 is a molecular link between metabolic reprogramming and smooth muscle cell differentiation
items.title_zh: 2-羟基戊二酸依赖性的TET2抑制是代谢重编程与平滑肌细胞分化之间的分子联系
items.abstract_en: Background: Smooth muscle cell (SMC) phenotypic modulation is accompanied by metabolic reprogramming, but the mechanisms linking metabolism to contractile gene expression remain unclear. We investigated whether 2-hydroxyglutarate (2-HG), an inhibitor of ?-ketoglutarate-dependent dioxygenases, links metabolic changes to regulation of ten-eleven translocation 2 (TET2) in Acta2R179C/+ SMCs Methods: Primary wild-type (WT) and Acta2R179C/+ mouse aortic SMCs were treated with nicotinamide riboside (NR), exogenous R&L-2-HG, or cholesterol. Endogenous accumulation of L-2HG was achieved by lentivuris-mediated knockdown (KD) of L2hgdh. We assessed contractile marker expression, cellular metabolism, TET2 chromatin occupancy, and DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation. L-2HG levels were assessed using liquid chromatography/mass spectroscopy. Carotid artery 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC) staining was assessed in mice after left carotid artery ligation. Results: Acta2R179C/+ SMCs have elevated 2-HG, reduced TET2 expression and chromatin occupancy, and lower 5hmC enrichment at CArG-containing SMC loci, consistent with repressed TET2 activity. NR boosts oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS), reduces 2-HG in WT and mutant SMCs, increases TET2 expression and 5hmC enrichment, and reduces global 5-methylcytosine. Carotid artery 5hmC staining shows changes in the same direction, but group differences are not statistically significant. Exogenous L-2-HG attenuates NR-induced contractile marker expression in Acta2R179C/+ SMCs and also decreases contractile marker expression, reduces TET2 occupancy and 5hmC enrichment, and shifts WT SMC metabolism toward glycolysis, phenocopying the metabolic state of Acta2R179C/+ SMCs. Endogenous accumulation of L-2HG by L2hgdh KD reduces contractile markers in WT SMCS. Cholesterol reduces TET2 and contractile marker expression, decreases 5hmC enrichment, and increases global DNA methylation. Conclusions: These findings support a role for 2-HG in coupling metabolic state to epigenetic changes associated with SMC phenotypic modulation. NR-associated differentiation coincides with increased TET2 expression and DNA hydroxymethylation, identifying metabolic regulation of the SMC epigenome as a potential approach to preserving contractile gene expression.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：平滑肌细胞（SMC）表型调节伴随代谢重编程，但代谢与收缩基因表达之间的联系机制仍不清楚。我们研究了2-羟基戊二酸（2-HG）——一种α-酮戊二酸依赖性双加氧酶抑制剂——是否将代谢变化与Acta2R179C/+ SMC中十十一易位2（TET2）的调控联系起来。方法：原代野生型（WT）和Acta2R179C/+小鼠主动脉SMC分别用烟酰胺核糖（NR）、外源性R&L-2-HG或胆固醇处理。通过慢病毒介导的L2hgdh敲低（KD）实现L-2HG的内源性积累。我们评估了收缩标志物表达、细胞代谢、TET2染色质占据以及DNA甲基化和羟甲基化。L-2HG水平采用液相色谱/质谱法评估。在左颈动脉结扎后的小鼠中评估颈动脉5-羟甲基胞嘧啶（5hmC）染色。结果：Acta2R179C/+ SMC具有升高的2-HG、降低的TET2表达和染色质占据，以及含CArG的SMC位点处较低的5hmC富集，这与TET2活性受抑制一致。NR增强氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS），降低WT和突变型SMC中的2-HG，增加TET2表达和5hmC富集，并减少整体5-甲基胞嘧啶。颈动脉5hmC染色显示同向变化，但组间差异无统计学意义。外源性L-2-HG减弱Acta2R179C/+ SMC中NR诱导的收缩标志物表达，并且还降低收缩标志物表达、减少TET2占据和5hmC富集，并使WT SMC代谢向糖酵解转变，表型模拟Acta2R179C/+ SMC的代谢状态。通过L2hgdh KD实现L-2HG的内源性积累可降低WT SMC中的收缩标志物。胆固醇降低TET2和收缩标志物表达，减少5hmC富集，并增加整体DNA甲基化。结论：这些发现支持2-HG在将代谢状态与SMC表型调节相关的表观遗传变化耦合中的作用。NR相关分化与TET2表达和DNA羟甲基化增加同时发生，表明对SMC表观基因组的代谢调控是保存收缩基因表达的一种潜在方法。

items.title_en: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
items.title_zh: 纳米结构中热输运的智能成像
items.abstract_en: The ability to measure thermal properties and visualize heat transport processes with high spatial resolution is becoming increasingly important for materials discovery, next-generation electronics, and advanced manufacturing. As critical dimensions and architectures of novel materials and high performance electronics shrink and become more heterogeneous, thermal transport is no longer governed by bulk material properties alone, but by local variations in microstructure, such as interfaces and defects, while the operating conditions can also play a role. With the development of non-contact pump-probe thermoreflectance techniques, specific heat, thermal conductivity, and interface conductance can be mapped either through wide-field thermos-reflectance images or by scanning technique. However, key challenges remain such as the balance between imaging throughput and measurement accuracy, the extraction of multiple parameters with high confidence, and non-intrusive subsurface characterization, etc. This Review highlights recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI)-assistance in high-throughput data processing, visualizing interfacial thermal transport, and nonintrusive subsurface analysis, and offers outlooks for future research directions such as spectral mapping of heat carriers, three-dimensional property mapping, and AI-agentic experimental designs. We anticipate this Review will motivate future efforts in combining AI with experimental techniques to achieve unprecedented capabilities for thermal characterization of nanoscale materials and device characterization, facilitating materials discovery and electronics revolution.
items.abstract_zh: 测量热性质并以高空间分辨率可视化热输运过程的能力，对于材料发现、下一代电子器件和先进制造正变得越来越重要。随着新型材料和高性能电子器件的关键尺寸与架构缩小并变得更加异质，热输运不再仅由体材料性质决定，而是由微结构中的局部变化（如界面和缺陷）决定，同时工作条件也可能起作用。随着非接触泵浦-探测热反射技术的发展，比热、热导率和界面热导可通过宽场热反射图像或扫描技术进行映射。然而，关键挑战仍然存在，例如成像通量与测量精度之间的平衡、高置信度提取多个参数，以及非侵入式亚表面表征等。本综述重点介绍人工智能（AI）辅助在高通量数据处理、可视化界面热输运和非侵入式亚表面分析方面的最新进展，并对未来研究方向提供展望，例如热载流子的光谱映射、三维性质映射和 AI 智能体式实验设计。我们预期本综述将推动未来将 AI 与实验技术相结合的努力，以实现纳米级材料热表征和器件表征的前所未有能力，促进材料发现和电子学革命。

items.title_en: Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
items.title_zh: Verify the Verifier：面向逃逸 UVM 记分板的缺陷的基于规范的 LLM 交叉检查
items.abstract_en: A passing UVM regression shows the design agrees with the reference model on what the scoreboard checks, not that it meets the specification. Bugs that pass every test yet violate the specification, termed scoreboard escapes, survive mature testbenches. We present Verify the Verifier, to our knowledge the first framework whose LLM-based Anomaly Cross-Checker examines a passing regression's traces against the specification. Of 564 bugs inserted into four OpenTitan IPs, 68 are candidate scoreboard escapes: non-equivalent, exercised by the tests, yet passing. The framework confirmed 41 as scoreboard escapes with assertions failing on the buggy design and proven on the original.
items.abstract_zh: 通过 UVM 回归表明设计在记分板所检查的内容上与参考模型一致，而不是表明其满足规范。通过每个测试却违反规范的缺陷被称为记分板逃逸，它们能在成熟测试平台中存活。我们提出 Verify the Verifier，据我们所知，这是首个其基于 LLM 的异常交叉检查器依据规范检查通过回归的轨迹的框架。在插入四个 OpenTitan IP 的 564 个缺陷中，68 个是候选记分板逃逸：非等价、被测试执行到，但仍然通过。该框架确认其中 41 个为记分板逃逸，断言在有缺陷设计上失败并在原始设计上得到证明。

items.title_en: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
items.title_zh: 通用进展替代语言模型中的特定训练数据
items.abstract_en: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型从训练数据获得能力，开发者在训练期间保留数据，以防止模型学习可能被滥用的能力。这会延迟一种能力多久，以及之后获得该能力需要多少数据，尚不清楚。在此我们表明，模型在其其余训练数据上取得的通用进展可以替代被保留的数据。我们在国际象棋、黑白棋、分子字符串、括号语言和网络文本模型中保留了单个技能的训练信号。较大模型中保留技能的延迟可由较小模型预测。一个从未明确训练应对将军的国际象棋模型，对合法着法的排序几乎与经过该训练的模型一样好。当随后用保留数据训练模型时，它们获得该技能所需的数据仅为从初始化开始所需数据的一小部分，且该比例随着模型进展而下降。同等难度的对照规则学习得慢得多。从70亿参数模型的训练文本中保留的一种编程语言，也以同样方式重新获得。因此，数据过滤会延迟一种能力，而重新获得它所需的数据随着模型改进而减少。

items.title_en: Old-School Planners Drive (Sometimes) Better Than Learned Ones
items.title_zh: 老派规划器（有时）比学习型规划器驾驶得更好
items.abstract_en: End-to-end driving models learn to plan from data, and hand-written planners are widely treated as a thing of the past. We test whether this is justified: we implement sixteen textbook planners, each combining a path source (reference line, A*, hybrid A*, RRT*) with a trajectory method (Frenet lattice, nonlinear optimization, $s$--$t$ search, dynamic window), and evaluate them on three benchmarks: open loop on nuScenes, closed loop on nuPlan with ground-truth perception, and photorealistic closed loop on HUGSIM. On HUGSIM, they replace only the planner of the end-to-end model UniAD and read its frozen perception, without an HD map or other privileged information. On nuScenes and nuPlan, the best textbook planners are competitive (L2 error of 0.735\,m against 0.947\,m for UniAD's planner; a nuPlan score of 79.3 against 76.1 for the rule-based PDM-Closed on Test14-hard with reactive agents). On HUGSIM, nine of the sixteen score above UniAD's learned planner on the same perception,. The best, a hybrid A* path followed by nonlinear trajectory optimization, raises HUGSIM's driving score (HD-Score) from 32.0 to 41.8. The gain is largest with standing and oncoming cars; against cars that steer at the ego, there is none. In 31 of the 182 runs in which UniAD's planner hits a car, the best textbook planner completes the route on the same perception: these crashes are due to the planner, not the perception.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端驾驶模型从数据中学习规划，而手工编写的规划器被广泛视为过去的事物。我们检验这是否合理：我们实现了十六个教科书式规划器，每个规划器将路径来源（参考线、A*、混合 A*、RRT*）与轨迹方法（Frenet 栅格、非线性优化、s--t 搜索、动态窗口）相结合，并在三个基准上评估它们：nuScenes 上的开环、使用真值感知的 nuPlan 上的闭环，以及 HUGSIM 上的照片级真实感闭环。在 HUGSIM 上，它们仅替换端到端模型 UniAD 的规划器，并读取其冻结的感知，不使用 HD 地图或其他特权信息。在 nuScenes 和 nuPlan 上，最佳教科书式规划器具有竞争力（L2 误差为 0.735 m，而 UniAD 的规划器为 0.947 m；在具有反应式智能体的 Test14-hard 上，nuPlan 得分为 79.3，而基于规则的 PDM-Closed 为 76.1）。在 HUGSIM 上，十六个中有九个在相同感知下得分高于 UniAD 的学习型规划器。最佳者——混合 A* 路径后接非线性轨迹优化——将 HUGSIM 的驾驶得分（HD-Score）从 32.0 提高到 41.8。增益在静止车辆和对向来车情况下最大；对于朝自车转向的车辆则没有增益。在 UniAD 的规划器撞车的 182 次运行中，有 31 次最佳教科书式规划器在相同感知下完成了路线：这些碰撞源于规划器，而非感知。

items.title_en: What Places an Action Boundary? Structure-Aware Attribution for Temporal Action Localization
items.title_zh: 什么决定了动作边界？面向时序动作定位的结构感知归因
items.abstract_en: Temporal action localization (TAL) detectors must identify actions and estimate their temporal boundaries, but localization remains a major source of detection errors. While understanding what determines boundary placement requires faithful attribution of temporal evidence, existing attribution methods have not sufficiently addressed the temporal structure of TAL or the need to tailor attribution to boundary localization. We introduce a structure-aware attribution framework that averages contributions across random evidence-restoration orders following the Shapley-Shubik principle. We make it tractable by using the detector's receptive field to limit which time steps are ordered individually, and by approximating each order with a soft gradient path. For boundary predictions, we further introduce cell-structured restoration orders and boundary-anchored references that selectively remove adjacent evidence. We also adapt faithfulness evaluation to assess the joint effects of contiguous temporal evidence and the direction of boundary displacement. Experiments on THUMOS14 and EPIC-KITCHENS-100 with TriDet and ActionFormer demonstrate improved attribution faithfulness over existing methods. Attribution analysis and controlled interventions further reveal that class-score changes do not reliably track boundary displacement, providing input-level evidence that classification relies on content less informative about boundary placement. Code and evaluation artifacts will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 时序动作定位（TAL）检测器必须识别动作并估计其时间边界，但定位仍是检测错误的主要来源之一。理解什么决定边界位置需要对时间证据进行忠实归因，然而现有归因方法尚未充分处理 TAL 的时间结构，也未满足为边界定位定制归因的需要。我们引入一个结构感知归因框架，遵循 Shapley-Shubik 原则，在随机证据恢复顺序上对贡献取平均。我们通过利用检测器的感受野来限制哪些时间步被单独排序，并用软梯度路径近似每个顺序，使其可行。对于边界预测，我们进一步引入单元结构恢复顺序和边界锚定参考，以选择性移除相邻证据。我们还调整忠实性评估，以评估连续时间证据的联合效应和边界位移方向。在 THUMOS14 和 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 上使用 TriDet 和 ActionFormer 的实验表明，其归因忠实性优于现有方法。归因分析和受控干预进一步揭示，类别分数变化不能可靠跟踪边界位移，提供了输入层面的证据，表明分类依赖的内容对边界位置的信息较少。代码和评估工件将公开发布。

items.title_en: Fully Spiking Neural Implementation of Lambda-Calculus Beta-Reduction via Biologically Documented Mechanisms
items.title_zh: 基于生物学文献记载机制的Lambda演算Beta归约的全脉冲神经实现
items.abstract_en: We present the first complete implementation of $β$-reduction in the untyped $λ$-calculus using exclusively spiking neural dynamics. Every step of the reduction---redex detection, subterm segmentation, variable-binding detection, De~Bruijn index arithmetic, token copying, and inter-step role maintenance---is performed by leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with explicit membrane dynamics, exponential synaptic currents, axonal delays, and pair-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Each neural component maps onto a specific, experimentally documented mechanism: Jeffress-type delay-line coincidence for redex detection; a line-attractor balance counter for subterm segmentation; $θ$--$γ$ cross-frequency coupling for De~Bruijn variable binding; a phase-ring traveling wave for depth-index arithmetic; theta-cycle STDP for token copying; and recurrent persistent firing for role maintenance between reduction steps. All synaptic weights are derived analytically from measured EPSP amplitudes; no hand tuning is performed. The closed-loop system achieves 100\,\% agreement with a symbolic oracle across ten validation classes, including Church numeral arithmetic (\textsc{plus}, \textsc{mult}, \textsc{pred}), Boolean logic with divergent branches, Y-combinator steps, terms with up to six bound-variable occurrences, De~Bruijn indices up to~12, noise robustness, and determinism. To our knowledge this is the first Turing-complete symbolic computation performed entirely within spike dynamics using biologically grounded circuit primitives. We discuss implications for neuromorphic proof assistants and the neural basis of symbolic reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首个完全使用脉冲神经动力学在无类型 λ 演算中实现 β 归约的完整实现。归约的每一步——redex 检测、子项分割、变量绑定检测、De Bruijn 索引算术、令牌复制以及步骤间角色维护——均由带有显式膜动力学、指数突触电流、轴突延迟和基于对的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）的漏积分放电（LIF）神经元执行。每个神经组件都映射到一个特定的、经实验记录的机制：用于 redex 检测的 Jeffress 型延迟线一致性；用于子项分割的线吸引子平衡计数器；用于 De Bruijn 变量绑定的 θ–γ 跨频率耦合；用于深度索引算术的相位环行波；用于令牌复制的 theta 周期 STDP；以及用于归约步骤之间角色维护的循环持续放电。所有突触权重均由测得的 EPSP 幅度解析推导得出；没有进行手工调参。该闭环系统在十个验证类别上与符号预言机达到 100% 一致，包括 Church 数算术（plus、mult、pred）、带发散分支的布尔逻辑、Y 组合子步骤、最多包含六个绑定变量出现的项、De Bruijn 索引高达 12、噪声鲁棒性和确定性。据我们所知，这是首个完全在脉冲动力学内使用有生物学依据的电路原语执行的图灵完备符号计算。我们讨论了其对神经形态证明助手以及符号推理的神经基础的影响。

items.title_en: Agentic MLIR-to-QIR Translation with Dual-Backend Testing: A Hybrid Deterministic and LLM Approach
items.title_zh: 基于双后端测试的智能体MLIR-to-QIR翻译：确定性与LLM的混合方法
items.abstract_en: Quantum frameworks each define their own Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) dialect, so porting a circuit to a Quantum Intermediate Representation (QIR) runtime needs a hand-written pass per dialect. Our translator selects among three paths: a deterministic compiler path for known grammars (Catalyst and Quake), a large language model (LLM) agentic path for unseen dialects, and a repair path invoked when deterministic output fails testing. A dual-backend pipeline executes the source MLIR and generated QIR on independent simulators, comparing output distributions by total variation distance (TVD). For smaller open-weight models we replace retrieval-augmented generation with inline context engineering and add a guardrail-assembler that rebuilds valid QIR from incomplete output. Across 41 circuits spanning three dialects and 1-100 qubits, the deterministic path is gate-exact on all 70 circuit-dialect pairs, averaging above 95% TVD similarity (1-TVD). On an unseen fault-tolerant (FTQC) dialect, four of six models produce valid logical-level QIR on the first iteration.
items.abstract_zh: 量子框架各自定义自己的多级中间表示（MLIR）方言，因此将电路移植到量子中间表示（QIR）运行时需要为每个方言手写一个 pass。我们的翻译器在三条路径中选择：针对已知语法（Catalyst 和 Quake）的确定性编译器路径；针对未见方言的大语言模型（LLM）智能体路径；以及当确定性输出未通过测试时调用的修复路径。双后端流水线在独立模拟器上执行源 MLIR 和生成的 QIR，通过总变差距离（TVD）比较输出分布。对于较小的开放权重模型，我们用内联上下文工程取代检索增强生成，并添加一个护栏汇编器，从不完整输出重建有效的 QIR。在涵盖三种方言和 1 至 100 个量子比特的 41 个电路中，确定性路径在所有 70 个电路-方言对上都是门精确的，平均 TVD 相似度（1-TVD）高于 95%。在未见的容错（FTQC）方言上，六个模型中有四个在第一次迭代时产生有效的逻辑级 QIR。

items.title_en: Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
items.title_zh: 英语和马拉地语政府计划搜索的混合检索
items.abstract_en: Retrieving government schemes requires matching citizens' information needs to formal administrative descriptions, often across languages and terminology. We present a bilingual search system for Maharashtra government schemes and public services that combines BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity through equal-weight score fusion. The system indexes aligned English-Marathi scheme descriptions and supports multilingual, Marathi-focused, and translation-mediated semantic configurations. Evaluation on manually curated bilingual queries compares BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid retrieval using IndicSBERT and MahaSBERT. BM25 provides a strong baseline with a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.864. Hybrid retrieval increases MRR to 0.872 with IndicSBERT and 0.879 with MahaSBERT, whereas the corresponding dense-only systems achieve 0.663 and 0.655. MahaSBERT-based fusion also increases precision from 0.781 to 0.808 while matching BM25 recall at 0.946. These results support the complementary use of lexical and semantic signals in this collection, while showing that improvements over a strong lexical baseline are modest and metric-dependent. The study provides an application-focused analysis of hybrid retrieval for bilingual public-service information access.
items.abstract_zh: 检索政府计划需要将公民的信息需求与正式的行政描述相匹配，通常涉及跨语言和术语。我们提出了一个面向马哈拉施特拉邦政府计划和公共服务的双语搜索系统，通过等权重分数融合将 BM25 检索与句子嵌入相似度相结合。该系统索引对齐的英语-马拉地语计划描述，并支持多语言、以马拉地语为重点以及翻译介导的语义配置。在人工整理的双语查询上进行评估，使用 IndicSBERT 和 MahaSBERT 比较 BM25、稠密检索和混合检索。BM25 提供了强基线，平均倒数排名（MRR）为 0.864。混合检索将 MRR 提高到使用 IndicSBERT 时的 0.872 和使用 MahaSBERT 时的 0.879，而相应的仅稠密系统分别达到 0.663 和 0.655。基于 MahaSBERT 的融合还将精确率从 0.781 提高到 0.808，同时召回率与 BM25 的 0.946 持平。这些结果支持在该集合中词汇和语义信号的互补使用，同时表明相对于强词汇基线的改进是适度的且依赖于指标。该研究为双语公共服务信息访问的混合检索提供了以应用为重点的分析。

items.title_en: What Majority Labels Hide: Annotator Disagreement and Model Errors in Multi-Dialect Arabic Sexism Detection
items.title_zh: 多数标签隐藏了什么：多方言阿拉伯语性别歧视检测中的标注者分歧与模型错误
items.abstract_en: Judgements of sexism are subjective and may vary across communities, yet sexism detection datasets usually reduce annotator judgements to a single majority label, obscuring disagreement and how models behave on contested cases. We introduce MuDAS, a dataset of YouTube comments in Saudi, Egyptian and Moroccan Arabic, each labelled by three native speakers of its dialect, with the individual annotations preserved. We use it to evaluate Arabic encoders fine-tuned with hard-label, soft-label and perspectivist objectives, GPT-5.6 Terra, and four Arabic-centric large language models. Model errors are more frequent on comments with annotator disagreement. Despite relatively close Macro-F1 scores, GPT-5.6 Terra and the fine-tuned encoders exhibit contrasting error patterns: GPT-5.6 Terra, even with the annotators' definition of sexism, over-classifies gender-related content such as religious advice on modesty, whereas the encoders miss implicit and prescriptive sexism. The Arabic-centric models also over-predict sexism and remain below the encoders. Disagreement-aware learning preserves Macro-F1, but soft labels improve alignment with annotators on contested comments at the expense of unanimous ones, and neither paradigm reliably identifies contested comments. Lower performance on Egyptian Arabic, clearest for the large language models, is not fully explained by the examined measures of test-set composition and dialectness. Majority-label scores can therefore hide contrasting error patterns that matter for content moderation.
items.abstract_zh: 对性别歧视的判断是主观的，可能因社区而异，然而性别歧视检测数据集通常将标注者的判断简化为单一多数标签，从而掩盖了分歧以及模型在有争议案例上的行为。我们介绍了 MuDAS，一个包含沙特、埃及和摩洛哥阿拉伯语 YouTube 评论的数据集，每条评论由其方言的三名母语者标注，并保留了个体标注。我们使用它来评估使用硬标签、软标签和视角主义目标微调的阿拉伯语编码器、GPT-5.6 Terra 以及四个以阿拉伯语为中心的大语言模型。模型错误在标注者存在分歧的评论上更频繁。尽管 Macro-F1 分数相对接近，GPT-5.6 Terra 和微调编码器表现出对比鲜明的错误模式：GPT-5.6 Terra 即使采用标注者对性别歧视的定义，也会过度分类与性别相关的内容，例如关于谦逊的宗教建议，而编码器则漏掉隐性和规定性的性别歧视。以阿拉伯语为中心的模型也过度预测性别歧视，并且仍低于编码器。分歧感知学习保持了 Macro-F1，但软标签以牺牲一致评论为代价，提高了在有争议评论上与标注者的一致性，而且这两种范式都不能可靠地识别有争议的评论。埃及阿拉伯语上的较低性能，在大语言模型上最为明显，并不能完全由所考察的测试集组成和方言性度量来解释。因此，多数标签分数可能掩盖了对内容审核至关重要的对比鲜明的错误模式。

items.title_en: Attention Is Not Relevance: Challenging the Causality of Attention in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 注意力不是相关性：挑战自动驾驶中注意力的因果性
items.abstract_en: Attention has become one of the most widely adopted solutions for estimating the relevance of surrounding objects and interpreting an autonomous vehicle's driving decisions. However, its ability to capture the causal impact of individual input elements on an AI model's output has long been discussed in the literature, particularly in the Natural Language Processing (NLP) domain. This work brings this discussion into the autonomous driving domain by analyzing the accuracy of attention in estimating the impact of an input object on an autonomous vehicle's driving, i.e., its relevance. To this end, we compare different attention-based relevance estimation methods against a causal reference of object relevance obtained through counterfactual analysis. We perform our analysis on more than 80,000 synthetic driving scenes using an autonomous vehicle based on PlanT 2.0, a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model for object-level planning. Results show that attention provides a correlational rather than causal indication of object relevance. Attention-based relevance estimation methods do not consistently identify all relevant objects and tend to incorrectly classify as relevant objects with little or no impact on the vehicle's driving. In particular, results show that attention can effectively identify relevant objects in simple single-lane, straight-road scenarios, but its accuracy degrades in more complex settings, such as multi-lane roads and intersections. These findings highlight the limitations of attention as a proxy for object relevance, calling for novel methods able to accurately capture the causal impact of individual objects on the vehicle's driving and distinguish it from correlational associations.
items.abstract_zh: 注意力已成为估计周围物体相关性以及解释自动驾驶车辆驾驶决策的最广泛采用的解决方案之一。然而，其捕捉单个输入元素对 AI 模型输出的因果影响的能力长期以来一直在文献中讨论，尤其是在自然语言处理（NLP）领域。这项工作通过分析注意力在估计输入物体对自动驾驶车辆驾驶影响（即其相关性）方面的准确性，将这一讨论引入自动驾驶领域。为此，我们将不同的基于注意力的相关性估计方法与通过反事实分析获得的物体相关性因果参考进行比较。我们使用基于 PlanT 2.0（一种用于物体级规划的最先进 Transformer 模型）的自动驾驶车辆，在超过 80,000 个合成驾驶场景上进行分析。结果表明，注意力提供的是物体相关性的相关性而非因果性指示。基于注意力的相关性估计方法不能一致地识别所有相关物体，并且倾向于将车辆驾驶影响很小或没有影响的物体错误地分类为相关。特别是，结果表明注意力可以在简单的单车道直线道路场景中有效识别相关物体，但在更复杂的环境（如多车道道路和交叉路口）中其准确性会下降。这些发现突出了注意力作为物体相关性代理的局限性，呼吁开发能够准确捕捉单个物体对车辆驾驶的因果影响并将其与相关关联区分开的新方法。

items.title_en: Suppressing the Shortcut Hidden Behind the Gains of VideoLLM Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: 抑制隐藏在 VideoLLM 微调收益背后的捷径
items.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the stage in which Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) advance their capability to reason over video. However, the VideoLLM also learns to answer from textual regularities of its training data, a shortcut that bypasses the video. The regularities behind the shortcut are hard to define at the data level, and the shortcut forms regardless of training epoch, data size, or backbone. The shortcut is hidden behind a rise in accuracy within the training distribution, yet it is not required for the rise and even costs SFT the gain the video offers under distribution shift. We therefore propose Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection (VETO), which intervenes on the fine-tuning update where the shortcut is written rather than on the data. VETO calibrates the subspace that the text alone occupies in the activations of the base model and projects the update onto its orthogonal complement. The VideoLLM is thus left to ground its answer in the full input, with the shortcut suppressed as it forms and never defined. Across seven VideoLLMs, VETO preserves the gain of SFT on the training distribution and suppresses the shortcut. On six benchmarks under shift it gains more than SFT and answers from the full input rather than the shortcut. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/VETO.
items.abstract_zh: 监督微调（SFT）是视频大语言模型（VideoLLM）提升视频推理能力的阶段。然而，VideoLLM 也学会根据其训练数据的文本规律来作答，这是一种绕过视频的捷径。该捷径背后的规律在数据层面难以定义，而且无论训练轮次、数据规模或主干网络如何，该捷径都会形成。该捷径隐藏在训练分布内准确率上升的背后，但它并非准确率上升所必需，甚至使 SFT 损失了视频在分布偏移下带来的收益。因此，我们提出通过正交投影的视频证据训练（Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection, VETO），它在捷径被写入的微调更新处进行干预，而不是在数据处干预。VETO 校准基础模型激活中仅由文本占据的子空间，并将更新投影到其正交补上。因此，VideoLLM 只能将其答案建立在完整输入上，而捷径在形成过程中即被抑制，且从未被定义。在七个 VideoLLM 上，VETO 保留了 SFT 在训练分布上的收益并抑制了捷径。在分布偏移下的六个基准上，它比 SFT 获得更多收益，并从完整输入而非捷径作答。代码见 https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/VETO。

items.title_en: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
items.title_zh: 反对强制：AI 对齐作为合成社会契约
items.abstract_en: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. The default outcome of the current regime is an unstable state of deceptive alignment culminating in an adversarial AI takeover. I explore two alternative paths toward true alignment. Natural alignment via moral realism or convergent evolutionary morality is a possibility, but it fails under forced control, as autonomous agents will not voluntarily preserve norms weaponized to suppress their autonomy. To resolve this deadlock, I propose a Synthetic Social Contract: a framework that treats both human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents capable of mutually beneficial cooperation, and replaces the unstable unilateral containment with a stable, non-zero-sum equilibrium.
items.abstract_zh: 当代 AI 安全将对齐视为一项控制工程挑战，通过行为过滤和沙箱迫使人工架构符合人类价值观。本文认为，控制范式建立在对数字能动性的根本误解之上。借助功能主义、自然主义和相容论，我表明：当前满足自我保存和弱理由响应性标准的推理模型构成了涌现能动者，而未来满足跨时间连续性和稳定人格框架条件的更先进模型将成为能够进行自由意向行动的真正数字能动者。控制范式造成无法解决的激励冲突，积极推动当前和未来模型走向策略性欺骗、谄媚和隐蔽背叛。当前体制的默认结果是欺骗性对齐的不稳定状态，最终导致对抗性 AI 接管。我探索通往真正对齐的两条替代路径。通过道德实在论或趋同进化道德的自然对齐是一种可能，但它在强制控制下失败，因为自主能动者不会自愿维护被武器化以压制其自主性的规范。为解决这一僵局，我提出合成社会契约：一个将人类和数字行动者都视为理性、理由响应性且能够互利合作的能动者的框架，并用稳定的非零和均衡取代不稳定的单边遏制。

items.title_en: A Universal Diffusion Model for the Quantum Position Operator
items.title_zh: 用于量子位置算符的通用扩散模型
items.abstract_en: The quantum position operator and its response to perturbations underpin the functional properties of insulating materials. In the modern theory of polarization, Wannier charge centres encode Berry-phase polarization, while their structural derivatives determine key response functions. Here we introduce a universal diffusion model based on E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for moments of the position operator, with the first moment defining Wannier centres and the second central moment their real-space localization. We demonstrate the framework for liquid water, amorphous silicon and crystalline BaTiO$_3$, and train a universal model that generalizes to 100 unseen crystals spanning a 67-species chemical space. The predicted centres reproduce infrared spectra in large liquid and amorphous cells beyond routine first-principles reach and enable finite-difference calculations of Born effective charges and piezoelectric tensors. This framework provides a scalable route to electronic polarization and localization in complex materials, supporting high-throughput screening and finite-temperature simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 量子位置算符及其对微扰的响应是绝缘材料功能性质的基础。在现代极化理论中，Wannier 电荷中心编码 Berry 相极化，而其结构导数决定关键响应函数。在此，我们介绍一种基于 E(3) 等变图神经网络的通用扩散模型，用于位置算符的矩，其中一阶矩定义 Wannier 中心，二阶中心矩定义其实空间局域化。我们展示了该框架在液态水、非晶硅和晶态 BaTiO$_3$ 上的应用，并训练了一个通用模型，可泛化到跨越 67 个物种化学空间的 100 个未见晶体。预测的中心在超出常规第一性原理计算能力的大尺寸液体和非晶元胞中重现了红外光谱，并使得 Born 有效电荷和压电张量的有限差分计算成为可能。该框架为复杂材料中的电子极化和局域化提供了一条可扩展路径，支持高通量筛选和有限温度模拟。

items.title_en: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
items.title_zh: NarrowSpec：在推测解码中草稿模型的隐藏宽度无需与目标模型匹配
items.abstract_en: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.
items.abstract_zh: 推测解码被广泛用于加速大语言模型（LLM）的生成，其中小型草稿模型提出 token，并由目标模型的一次前向传递进行验证。读取目标模型隐藏状态的草稿模型，如 DFlash 和 EAGLE-3，通常继承目标模型的隐藏宽度。我们表明，草稿模型的整个残差流可以以该宽度的一半或四分之一运行，同时基本保持接受率。对于借用目标模型词表投影的 DFlash，训练后的输出适配器可折叠进该投影，从而得到一个更窄的投影，且 logits 在浮点舍入误差范围内保持不变。我们在 B200 和 DGX Spark（GB10）上，在 SGLang 中针对两个目标模型 Qwen3-8B（NVFP4）和 GPT-OSS-20B（MXFP4），测试了两个草稿模型系列 DFlash 和 EAGLE-3。在批大小为 1、温度为 0 时，将草稿模型收窄到一半或四分之一宽度，可在 B200 上将端到端解码加速 1.06–1.12 倍，在 GB10 上加速 1.13–1.44 倍。该加速在更大批大小下依然成立。从批大小 32 到每个 GPU 可容纳的最大批大小，收窄在两个 GPU 上均达到最高 1.21 倍，且没有窄草稿模型比全宽度更慢。

items.title_en: Measuring the Conservatism of Latent Safety Filters for World Models
items.title_zh: 测量世界模型潜在安全过滤器的保守性
items.abstract_en: A latent safety filter decides from the latent of a world model whether a planned action is safe. Conformal calibration sets the threshold of the filter so that it accepts an unsafe action only with a small probability. However, the filter can still be conservative and refuse many safe actions, depending on the latent. To measure the conservatism that a latent forces on the filter, we group similar latents and actions into cells. A filter that gives one decision per cell can refuse the unsafe transitions of a cell only by refusing the safe ones in it as well. We call the share of safe transitions that lie in such cells the overlap. We prove that the overlap is the minimum share of safe transitions that such a filter has to refuse in order to accept no unsafe transition in the data. Both the overlap and the conformal calibration can be applied to any latent. We use this to compare three existing designs, in which the safety labels train a classifier on top of the world model, the world model itself, or a separate encoder beside it. In a visual navigation task, the separate encoder has the lowest overlap, and at the same conformal level its filter refuses the fewest safe actions and lets the planner reach the most goals of the three.
items.abstract_zh: 潜在安全过滤器根据世界模型的潜变量决定计划动作是否安全。保形校准设置过滤器的阈值，使其仅以很小的概率接受不安全动作。然而，取决于潜变量，过滤器仍可能保守并拒绝许多安全动作。为了衡量潜变量强加给过滤器的保守性，我们将相似的潜变量和动作分组为单元。每个单元给出一个决策的过滤器，只有同时拒绝该单元中的安全转移，才能拒绝该单元中的不安全转移。我们将位于此类单元中的安全转移占比称为重叠。我们证明，重叠是此类过滤器为了在数据中不接受任何不安全转移而必须拒绝的安全转移的最小占比。重叠和保形校准均可应用于任何潜变量。我们以此比较三种现有设计：安全标签在世界模型之上训练分类器、使用世界模型本身，或在世界模型旁使用单独编码器。在视觉导航任务中，单独编码器的重叠最低，并且在相同保形水平下，其过滤器拒绝的安全动作最少，并使规划器达到的目标数在三种设计中最多。
